clean_body: There are two kinds of Members in Congress, and they're not Democrats and Republicans. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more There are two kinds of Members in Congress, and they're not Democrats and Republicans. | | | Sep 8 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- First thing to know: it's really hard to get to the US House of Representatives. Bill Clinton lost a House race in 1974, George W. Bush lost one in 1978 and so did Barack Obama in 2000. Three future presidents, all of them tried and failed to get to the House. | | ---|---|--- I made it in 2022, in one of the most competitive House races in the country, flipping one of just six Republican seats in the whole nation from red to blue. It was brutal. But here's the funny part: once you're in, the system practically bolts you to the chair. Your odds of getting re-elected? 97%. The whole thing is built to protect incumbents, and it works like a charm. Poll after poll says the same thing: Americans hate Congress, but they love their own member of Congress. So here's what to expect once you get there. You get paid $174,000 a year, a number that hasn't budged since 2009. You also get an official budget of close to $2 million a year, and you can spend it pretty much however you want. Most of it goes to staff, the folks who answer the phones, track legislation, and help constituents untangle their problems with federal agencies. The rest covers your travel, your district office rent, communications, big dry-erase checks and the other costs of the job. | | ---|---|--- The message here is simple: you get to choose your own adventure. Spend your time and your budget how you see fit. And the best members are the ones who actually use all of it to make people's lives better. In my two years, my office answered more than 70,000 questions from constituents and helped over 1,600 of them fix problems with federal agencies, clawing back nearly $2.8 million that was rightfully theirs. It's a great way to make a lot of friends. It's also, not coincidentally, how you end up on the right side of that 97% figure. Most members are doing that work, and it's genuinely good. But it's not the whole story. The question I really want to answer is the bigger one: why isn't Congress working? | | ---|---|--- Here's what nobody tells you until you get there. There are two kinds of members, and I'm not talking about Democrats and Republicans. I'm talking about the 90% who got elected in safe seats and the less than 10% who came from real battlegrounds. If you're in a safe seat, you're basically guaranteed re-election as long as you win your primary. And almost nobody loses their primary. So the only thing you really have to worry about is your own party's base if you're part of that 90%. There's zero incentive to talk to the people in the middle or work across the aisle. That's a big part of why the last Congress was one of the least productive since 1860. You don't have to get anything done to keep your job. You just have to keep your base happy. | | ---|---|--- Now compare that to the battleground members, the ones in truly competitive districts like mine was. There's only about 40 of us left out of 435, and that number keeps shrinking. You can thank gerrymandering for that. When your district could go either way, you're forced to do the thing Congress is supposed to do: listen to everybody, find the middle, get something done. And if you can pull that off, you're effective no matter who runs the House, the Senate, or the White House. That's the whole game, really. Most members want to stay because the perks are great and you can do real good with the job. And thanks to safe seats and the incumbency advantage, staying is a whole lot easier than getting there was. Congress would work much better if more members had to earn it every two years instead of coasting, if they were rewarded for working across the aisle instead of getting into partisan food fights. | | ---|---|--- As for me, Republican gerrymandering in North Carolina erased my district and took my 97% down to 0% with one stroke of a pen. But I still believe in the US Congress, and in the members who show up and do the right thing every day. It comes down to paying attention. The more people understand what their member is actually up to, and push them to serve everyone they represent, the better our democracy works. -- Wiley P.S. That thing everybody says about members of Congress getting free health care and pensions for life? Not true. You're treated like any other federal employee and you pay into the retirement system out of every paycheck, same as everyone else. You have to serve five years for a pension, and then you only get a slice of your salary. For a member who serves five-years, that's about $8,700 a year. Not exactly a golden parachute. P.P.S. Want to hear what it was really like for Jeff Jackson to serve alongside me in Congress? Come find out. body:
It’s not too late — but it’s close| | | [](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=3aa8cd9b3e9649128b6087ab1bbe4743&_e=a6U0vzddOjzxGTRDoLvQJuoKGViWSkAuuDFY2kVmSHDk7bjhPClIcSDUL3QEkZrqZkvAGBShmWKJEICBv7HKBfE9oRW4rrEvgQBDFI2FMPDkij2R7QjldOl1Oh9VZq9X4K_dBnsAicpAJVQV6akrwetlYtDfrVpWGLyMqxmCtZSXkRR27yXAEGh2Gc-28I2UnRVkUOaSVw3etO4AHSDp5mpN36BVwOVkd_VGXeYZR0mHSXEWwcty7Ux_ivASj2s7Xq6ewL7ggWK2rJtjDk6q4bz5rFoh8ohAswRKr87sUg5jLcZuQpox8yg7nvOfSURDAU6FfHjBfyEYoABghdC47eVXPUi7tckVmmatimxEOpWwco_AaGGp4ikjHvQLVqL_YRWluvwXe7XFjNVxI2FUTiIaaoUoJ0vTdmkKRGvKTwYSn69C8E31r3pHjQfz8n0Jgm1vhYkyYWA1Fh0e3svlK2Xb1vfwfGR_FWNFdEvIqyGRP28Bw4Z3_pdsFVlSZaiPurW8-hqWv2vWAd0hOu1zAv9FsjY8f2syWRW2HsHpQBgjdT7cQZr15ohMXJTVXRgjlAM9mUhjK8piXyOIL5K9CoF0K1Oq3sM8FSFZSgWoqcvjVhd_rwytEUQTaewiuJpeEo9TBAEXmeqHh15jpnxOwS1HAS_l_cC_xJJQbg2qqbfgP9GemQveiHCPlt3c5qt6G6girqjF4-92E5YRT8Fk8REopnEkIIO_BWpvt26Vv7E%3D)
---
| | Patriot,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=3aa8cd9b3e9649128b6087ab1bbe4743&_e=a6U0vzddOjzxGTRDoLvQJuoKGViWSkAuuDFY2kVmSHDk7bjhPClIcSDUL3QEkZrqZkvAGBShmWKJEICBv7HKBfE9oRW4rrEvgQBDFI2FMPDkij2R7QjldOl1Oh9VZq9X4K_dBnsAicpAJVQV6akrwetlYtDfrVpWGLyMqxmCtZSXkRR27yXAEGh2Gc-28I2UnRVkUOaSVw3etO4AHSDp5mpN36BVwOVkd_VGXeYZR0mHSXEWwcty7Ux_ivASj2s7-SpLhq1UWwcgEZToss66cHOU5_ZrMe2qYTgZeVvPk7mR3Kc-HvQpScEIsmGGg1lFDIzz3ZMFlpRAARBq8vNm80rldIvEisQhpDFxDvIV0g7ZSnFvOcHwkFKjAgmU9QNHjetYKHnoz2heHQf-QkLl6_HAjrBUCxPDy_3E2mH_q9I9lR_7U5kgvlBjVUYKEyiWHknlpsAiim_AuxzFec-PJplES7RbnUizMQmlmwqCkhboQuoHtvt53YflojlmY1AGi_K6bjNuFVRdvKzSSZ683JnsYJbUda17Tas23bQT7rG1SDh3iSGdYdU5CgNm6mSWUxvFZbOVEI1y6-5kPQM3xUm0rXoG-5BZZmgJH-oU8NYZqimiCSL-DXI1eE2rvrK7txIWSXPSNyNd7-TVGqbPMM6EoCZmVNf_ACGo_fVJu_hUEAE5NftjuFtK3GnzVet0066vj5w81Z3-raPFGAkoUBHzPQY4T-EAICOsNFzFNBY%3D)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

On January 3rd, 2021, I stood in the House chamber and swore to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic.

Three days later, the Capitol was attacked, and I had a choice to make: _be a politician, or be a patriot._

**I put our republic first: I served on the January 6th Committee, seeking truth, justice, and accountability for the American people.**

That decision may have cost me my House seat in 2022, after an onslaught of MAGA cash targeted our district. But I’d make the same choice all over again, because I swore an oath—the same oath I swore at 17 when I entered the Naval Academy—to protect the country I love.

**That’s why I’m running for Congress in 2026.**

I’m running to help families get ahead instead of just getting by, to ensure veterans get the support they need, and to defend our Constitution.

These aren’t just talking points, Peter. **We _can win this_**. We’ve already done so twice before. And last November, Virginians proved they’re intent on a new direction.

I’m ready to bring tough leadership to communities across Hampton Roads, but I can’t go it alone. I’m counting on patriots like you to join me on the right side of history.

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: The antidote to Drag Queen Story Hour
body:
We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded
ALA.

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e926140/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvTUNyUGt5TUpjNg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA5MDg/LbmNscExCU0V6YQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNaMU50d0U4Y1FLeDlsc10/gaqAMDQ/s2v09713b57

Patriot,

If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox
News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, PLEASE LET ME
TELL YOU WHY IT’S SO CRITICAL.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the
library with a kind but stern librarian.

She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny _and _The
Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam
by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_,
_Treasure Island _and _Charlotte’s Web_.

BUT TODAY, ALL THAT HAS CHANGED.

Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of
the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used
to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+
writers and voices.’

Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn _and _To Kill
a Mockingbird _“racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls
Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her
“problematic’ _Little House _series.

And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for
“Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to
children of all ages...

A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their
kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism,
environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else
that activists believe in and fight for.”

Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a
new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the
air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change
the world.”

Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a
prince who marries a knight instead of a princess.

And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A
“family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to
“work it.”

I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New
York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.

[Image showing people, person, and baby]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour”

THAT’S WHY PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS ACROSS THE COUNTRY ARE RISING UP
THROUGH SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and
George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.

AND AS A RESULT, A NEW GENERATION OF PINK-HAIRED, ACTIVIST LIBRARIANS
HAVE MADE IT THEIR MISSION TO FILL LIBRARY SHELVES WITH ANTI-AMERICAN,
LGBTQ-FRIENDLY, AND EXPLICITLY SEXUAL CONTENT.

Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library
celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type
of religion.

Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to
be a “parent-free” zone.

The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick _about a
cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa _filled with graphic nudity, and
_Darkstalker _featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.

BUT HERE’S WHAT’S REALLY ALARMING.

We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my
family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t
check out those inappropriate books.”

That may be good for your family -- for now.

BUT MEANWHILE, THE ALA USES OUR TAXPAYER-FUNDED LIBRARIES TO LURE IN
MILLIONS OF OTHER CHILDREN WHO GROW UP TO BE THE VERY ACTIVISTS WHO
ARE DESTROYING OUR COUNTRY AND CONSERVATIVE VALUES!

I HOPE YOU SEE WHY I NEED YOUR HELP TODAY.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

My name is Kirk Cameron.

Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing
Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof”
and “Left Behind.”

I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist
values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.

But the gospel saved me.

I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a
husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.

When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to
indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America
messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.

So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children
how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.

THEN I DECIDED TO GO ONE STEP FURTHER AND COUNTER THOSE AWFUL “DRAG
QUEEN STORY HOURS” WITH CONSERVATIVE STORY HOURS FILLED WITH THE
CLASSIC BOOKS YOU AND I GREW UP WITH, PLUS NEW WHOLESOME BOOKS LIKE
MINE THAT CAPTIVATE CHILDREN WITH LESSONS IN BRAVERY, HONESTY,
KINDNESS, AND PATRIOTISM.

And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit.

* Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.

* The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out
including booking all the event rooms for themselves.

* Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi
(that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse
and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored
moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and
on.

I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so
vile.

In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them
that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.

AND THOUSANDS OF PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS BROUGHT THEIR LITTLE ONES TO
THOSE “STORY HOURS” WHERE WE PLEDGED ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG, SANG
“GOD BLESS AMERICA”, AND READ WHOLESOME AND GODLY BOOKS.

It was incredible.

But here’s the greatest part...

From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could
host “Story Hours” of their own.

And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement
was born.

Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at
201 libraries in 46 states.

On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”

filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.

Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a
very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and
reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries.

AND THIS YEAR, HONORING AMERICA’S 250TH BIRTHDAY, MY AMBITIOUS GOAL
IS TO EXPAND “SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY” TO REACH 250,000
CHILDREN.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you!

The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host
“Story Hours” has been overwhelming.

That’s a very good thing.

But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these
volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for
250,000 children.

THAT’S WHY I’VE TEAMED WITH A VERY SPECIAL NON-PROFIT CALLED BRAVE
FOR GOOD TO MAKE THIS YEAR’S “SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY” A
BIGGER SUCCESS THAN EVER.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

BRAVE FOR GOOD was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian
publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots
were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with
a tax-deductible gift.

YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT HELPS SEND A ‘STORY HOUR KIT’ TO EVERY
PARENT, GRANDPARENT, AND PATRIOT WHO’S ORGANIZING A “SEE YOU AT
THE LIBRARY” EVENT.

The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative
values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their
library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for
little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards,
and other specialty items.

YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT IS THE ONLY WAY WE CAN FUND OUR “STORY
HOURS” FOR 250,000 CHILDREN TO COUNTER THE RADICAL LEFTISTS WHO’VE
TAKEN CONTROL OF OUR LIBRARIES.

We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded
ALA.

KNOWING THAT, PLEASE CONSIDER A SPONSORSHIP GIFT OF $125. THAT’S
ENOUGH TO SPONSOR ONE ENTIRE ‘STORY HOUR KIT’ YOURSELF.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome,
Godly, and patriotic message.

WHATEVER YOU CAN GIVE WHETHER IT’S $35, $125, OR ANYTHING HIGHER OR
LOWER PLEASE SEND IN YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT IN THE NEXT 48 HOURS SO WE
KNOW HOW MANY LIBRARIES WE HAVE SPONSORED FOR THIS YEAR’S “SEE YOU
AT THE LIBRARY DAY.”
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,

KIRK CAMERON

AND AS A RESULT, A NEW GENERATION OF PINK-HAIRED, ACTIVIST LIBRARIANS HAVE MADE IT THEIR MISSION TO FILL LIBRARY SHELVES WITH ANTI-AMERICAN, LGBTQ-FRIENDLY, AND EXPLICITLY SEXUAL CONTENT. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. BUT HERE’S WHAT’S REALLY ALARMING. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family -- for now. # Conforti Grassroots Newsletter
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

Welcome to our interactive grassroots newsletter. As we approach the Midterm Election 2026, this newsletter is dedicated to keeping the hardworking constituents of Illinois' 6th Congressional District informed and engaged.

Our campaign is built on a "district-first" mentality. We are committed to prioritizing your needs, focusing on fundamental ideals of sensible solutions and open dialogue. Through this newsletter, we will provide you with regular updates on policy, campaign events, and current community events happening right here in our district.
Click the button below to make a donation today. Your donations are what makes this possible.
---
| | [DONATE](https://us.list-manage.com/uF1YPrwnkfI?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)
---
| |
---
| |
## Kitchen Table Tuesday.
The Conforti Brief.
District-First Events.
---
| |
### Educate. Inform. Invite.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
# Kitchen Table Tuesday
---
| | **Educating and connecting** with voters on important issues.
---
| | |
---
| | Illinois families are already stretched to the limit, yet **we continue to be burdened by higher taxes and rising tolls.** While we all agree our communities need real infrastructure improvements, we shouldn't have to accept bloated bills to fix our roads and bridges. I strongly oppose any further tax and fee hikes on hardworking Illinoisans.
.My priority is to **pass clean infrastructure legislation—funding that focuses strictly on the physical upgrades our district needs** , not payouts for special interests. I am running to curb reckless spending, demand responsible funding, and finally stop the cycle of endless tax increases.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
## The Conforti Brief
---
| | **Informing voters** on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office.
---
| | **Common-Sense Solutions Over Socialist Agendas**
.The U.S. House of Representatives recently voted to pass a **resolution that strongly condemns socialism "in all its forms."** The measure was adopted with a 220 to 192 to 2 vote, with eight Democrats crossing party lines to vote with Republicans. The resolution was presented following primary wins by candidates identifying as democratic socialists.
.Incumbent **Sean Casten voted against the measure** to condemn socialism for the second time, in an effort to appease and placate the radical elements of his party.
.Niki Conforti will serve in Congress as a voice of "common-sense" solutions that puts the district first. If elected, **Conforti will support legislation that benefits the 6th District** , including:
.
* **Job Creation:** Expanding workforce training programs and helping connect hard-working Illinoisans with good-paying jobs.
.
* **Stimulating Economic Growth:** Stimulating the return of manufacturing to the 6th District and getting people back to work.
.
* **Lowering Energy and Healthcare Costs:** Cutting regulations in the energy industry to make energy more affordable. Niki will also push for transparency in medical billing to drive down prices for patients.
.
* **Improving Infrastructure & Stopping Tax Hikes:** Curbing spending in Washington to stop tax increases on working families, while focusing on real improvements in the budget.
.

Stay informed on this issue—[**read the full breakdown here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/2HdxzvAOfkS?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)

---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
# District-First
# Events
---
| | **Inviting voters** to community events and how they can get involved!**
**Join the Conforti Campaign at**2026 Autumn In The Park Festival!**
---
| |
---
| | **Join the Conforti Campaign at the 2026 Autumn In The Park Festival!
**.We warmly invite you to participate and walk alongside Niki Conforti and our campaign team at the **Palos Park Autumn In The Park Festival Parade!** Come out to show your support for our "District-First" vision and join the community for this wonderful tradition.

* **Date:** Saturday, September 19, 2026
* **Time:** The parade steps off at 1:00 PM.
* **Location/Route:** The parade kicks off at 83rd Avenue on 123rd Street in Palos Park and travels westbound to 90th Avenue ending near the festival grounds.
* **Post-Parade:** A lively festival will be running from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM on the Village Green (8901 W. 123rd St). The festival will feature food vendors, artisan vendors, kids activities, and live musical entertainment!
.

**Join the Conforti Campaign at the Worth Township Republican Meeting!**
You are invited to join Niki Conforti and our campaign team at the upcoming **Worth Township Republican Organization meeting!** This event is a fantastic opportunity to hear Niki speak about our campaign's focus on economic affordability, community safety, and bringing a true "district-first" mentality to Washington. Come out to meet Niki and share your vision for the district with local leaders and neighbors.

* **Date:** Wednesday, September 23, 2026
* **Location:** Oak Lawn VFW (Johnson-Phelps VFW Post #5220), 9514 S. 52nd Ave., Oak Lawn, IL 60453

We would love to have you join our ranks for these special events! To get more details, please contact our team at [**info@conforti4congress.com.**](mailto:info@conforti4congress.com?subject=Event%3A%202026%20Autumn%20In%20The%20Park%20Festival&body=)

We look forward to seeing you there!.
.
.
**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (DuPage County)**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot:**August 5th**
* Early voting and vote-by-mail voting begins: **September 24th**
* Last day to request a vote-by-mail ballot: **October 29th**
* Last day for early voting: **November 2nd**
* General Election Day:**November 3rd**
.

**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (Cook County)**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot: **August 5th**
* First day to vote early in Chicago (Downtown Only): **September 24th** Last day for online voter registration: **October 18th**
* Early voting opens in all 50 city wards and suburban Cook County: **October 19th**
* Deadline for vote-by-mail applications: **October 29th**
* General Election Day: **November 3rd**
.

**Get out the vote:** whether you plan to vote by mail, early voting in person, or voting in person on election day, it’s important we get out the vote to defeat incumbent Sean Casten.

I’m grateful for you, Peter.
I’ve been able to rely on top supporters like you during our biggest moments, and today, [**_I need your help once again._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1304&amount=5&t=8&akid=3246%2E124072%2EbPiAsP)
We’re less than 60 days out from the start of early voting in this election. I know it can be easy to get lost in the endless stream of countdowns and deadlines, but they’re real checkpoints for our campaign. Elections are won or lost along the margins, and building our momentum from one day to the next is the only way we’ll succeed.
Right now, the GOP is doubling down on its attacks against me. Super PACs are spending nearly $100 million so far to push out TV ads that lie about me. MAGA loyalist Stephen Miller is going on Fox News to smear me.
It’s not surprising that they’re stooping to such lows – because experts say our race in NC will decide Senate control. However, it is alarming, and **I need your help to fight back.**
The latest poll shows that their attacks may be working, as it shows my lead shrinking, and whether we’re able to meet our fundraising goals will determine if we’re able to turn this thing around.
[**_I’d be grateful for your $5 donation today if you can spare it. It all adds up quickly when many grassroots donors like you are pitching in. name: Alex Vindman
subject: My friend Fred Wellman
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
Peter —
The headlines always talk about the same set of competitive, national races that will decide who controls Congress. And while those races are crucial for Democrats to win, there are plenty of races that have gone under the radar that will have just as much of an impact on the people who live there.
**I could think of no other race that fits this description more than the race my friend Fred Wellman is running over in Missouri’s Second Congressional District.**
I’ve known Fred for a long time. We’re both veterans of the Iraq War. We’ve seen the horrors of battle all too close. And we have continued our service by elevating the voices of veterans across the country through VoteVets.
All that is to say, I know that Fred is a fighter. He never gives up on the people he serves, and as a Congressman, he will be a fiercely loyal representative to the people of Missouri and make some noise.
But he’s facing a challenge that hasn’t been covered enough. While he’s building unprecedented grassroots support and running an incredible campaign, his opponent is one of the wealthiest and most well-connected people in Washington.
Her entire campaign has been well-funded by corporations and MAGA-aligned super PACs, and that’s not even counting what Trump’s personal super PAC will do to interfere in the race.
So Fred needs your help. And we don’t have a lot of time.
[**That’s why I’m proud to endorse my good friend Fred Wellman and match contributions up to a total of $33,500 to his campaign before his end-of-the month deadline. These House races are just as critical to support as the races who make national headlines, and in some cases, your contribution will go farther when you support them. So help my friend with any amount you can give.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-fredwellman?refcode=em260908-2&amount=3&refcode2=1101_3892029_IXQpXJ&akid=1101%2E3892029%2EIXQpXJ)

clean_body: | = Peter, I had to reach out because now it's official: I'm facing Trump-anointed Darline Graham Nordone in November. Darline, by her own words, isn't "that informed on national security" and can’t "control the PAC money coming in." This is a woman running for an office only 100 Americans get the responsibility of holding. The Senate isn’t the place for on the job training, Peter. And we know with all the cozying up to Donald Trump Darline has done during her short campaign, she will go along with every facet of his agenda. We cannot let that happen, Peter. body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138774915/645181800/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZDVkMzg5Yy04ZGFiLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DJdgLFFg_tELh3yOABUagIfc4FUSCJ3DW37rIQ00a-s=)

Peter,

I never looked up to politicians as a kid. I didn't know much about them, and I don't think I would have cared very much if I did. But there was someone I looked up to then, and still look up to today: **My 9-to-5 icon, the Queen of Country, Dolly Parton.**

I grew up in a trailer in a small rural town, and country music was the background sound of life. Dolly's voice was a BIG part of that soundtrack. I loved the way she sang about family, about working for a paycheck, and about growing up with very little but having big dreams anyway.

When Dolly passed, I found myself thinking about her songs and the pieces of wisdom she left behind. She sang that sometimes we have to pour ourselves “a cup of ambition,” and about how a mother’s love made an old motley-colored coat beautiful.**But as much as I love the music, I keep coming back to the goodness Dolly brought into the world.**

Through her Imagination Library, millions of children have received free books from birth to age five, giving so many kids their first chance to discover the joy of reading. Her foundation has helped students pursue their education. She gave generously to communities recovering from disasters and supported healthcare efforts, including work to help children facing devastating diseases. Again and again, when Dolly saw a way to help someone, she did.

Dolly once said: **“You'll never do a whole lot unless you're brave enough to try.”** We don't have to be Dolly Parton to do some good in the world. We don't have to have millions of dollars or millions of fans. We just have to be willing to try. To stand up when something isn't right. To believe that the future can be better, and then do something.

I could go on and on about Dolly. I could probably sing “I Will Always Love You” right now if you asked. (Although between you and me, you would probably regret that request!) [**Instead, today I'm not asking you for a donation. I'm asking you to do something much simpler. Will you sign my pledge to keep fighting for a brighter future? Dolly spent her life showing us that doing good can be its own kind of legacy. That is why I’m running for Congress, and following in her footsteps is the best way I can think of honoring her.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138774917/645181802/-1953793788?ms=em26_260908_dol_engg_gq_act___CB_ettx&refcode=em26_260908_dol_engg_gq_act___CB_ettx&source=em26_260908_dol_engg_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260908_dol_engg_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=/b98psghoJ/P0Njd47LgI603j8bLMxT6t32YUGTWIv3YgdYmwyXi2RFdSm15UWPU/go322UQpVtBel2ZyOq9e3Z+pg/0gkSKGnoscr3oQneghdbyr5lq48ZfgjmJtYVy565sL4aE8IL7RVAwO7kfmoVf0l1gO2P3N3MxqRZJFIg=&refcode2=cd5d389c-8dab-f111-9b33-0022482a933b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZDVkMzg5Yy04ZGFiLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DJdgLFFg_tELh3yOABUagIfc4FUSCJ3DW37rIQ00a-s=&emci=a007ae23-81a8-f111-9b33-0022482a933b&emdi=cd5d389c-8dab-f111-9b33-0022482a933b&ceid=13891890)

Christina

Angie Nixon just won Florida's Democratic Senate primary. Here's why that matters more than you know. |
Peter,

I need to tell you something about what happened in Florida, and [**I need you to understand that this isn't about money.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b46bf69175fa4d17bea5f088b5e032b0&_e=EXCh2d-fq_UNcpVcdql0S6uc5l1PzQW3VPq_OGXCc-fI1TX8F6pWYLPd5rn9JClxo6QzNQ6bYpxiL16ehJ40-ocY1VaI8pk56TFyPM1SsJLLw4gKcz4mPyXQopK8XYp8kWrJTowMOiny4X8ehdKKz3PYgGt-JvtvLIS1nYQVZ0IH3X2qnAp2bvIwykPQUIufDDwehe-yAl8wbtfhUxBl-hv3Tt1SLKjdD8iqCKKM5IqKfRhQ9mf9DTql4KkG9HfnZdxnknocQ2Au-zYibxPsLu41hkUsovg6_K0Nt5zIdwAjX2vkGEg_KqFQjai2bclbLRSxgR9J1RbcAwgRwQEI_eOcb1i2RZ_mreW8-dRplCr9YnPDLpY8T3-TzuV9-lfKmF_Fd1HtbaYrxHmW2tFYvgvuaSz9qBtBh1M0Mc11jPenA_eqSvZSWdCtU5EUTpwJhxq4rQm8ZEXHzWDVEhw2QTgernD0maStzzxO_a0b1W6-L5upX3L9XNnhuNykOxw9uGDapY-XhE5rmPKdzEjX-CYiqMwuF4C8WrVIzag8kXqihEC5YoVcUNJJ_tUh83keEM4BfkC9ID8vkTCnY--JYxida16bwQIkI0k622RAOBkoSF_te-fzuwBROrKPAr-tzzfcVG-rRE6m5xXTmklbYDixmrAe0ba5xoVvsL_r7tCWSCZijtiAyvNIgwYzEkU2l94PyQnN8n_FxHaArbOGLkQ77tOxzRHelCVZIIkLLJOupnh85iacmc4x3YA1J9mwthFQYMIiYNiPP_JaX6kkSxXW7asg1KadvuF8G30VfEvag_diNhpD8CBnvo22SVZNLHwjonsp_OV5JLgFHLmLSv4Zm0p3rVfH0YfoabL1KcbmnV8hdoG0i3fC7PRICcSZqSE5sbT9nb-vgO2j7ovW1QJQ2KQyWxktIPqXSc3ANArGRqy7kOQ9S8DKUpbGJqy85IMCQDJFuvkePqvkU6U-wxt3tD_CegsBl1cCs5rvpGoPwI3FcPO1fsIR-WOjfFCqct9lFxVS4WWlExymNLu9M-ngk3XdzB7JD8dtdI5krdGO_JyURzyZwDQAeUoB-YkWhN0Ua2iMOXWGlZIRNJ4s2Y8FTXkhN3rjWKmue7Mtdfg%3D)

Angie Nixon just won the Florida Democratic Senate primary. She raised a fraction of what her opponent had. She was outspent 16 to 1. And she won anyway, by 12 points.

That should stop every Republican in their tracks.

Because here's what that result tells me. For the first time in history, a member of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) has won a major-party nomination for statewide office. The DSA, the same movement that swept New York and is reshaping the Democrat Party from the inside, just planted their flag in Florida. And they did it without the money.

Nixon's win caught many off guard. Now the party has a DSA-aligned Senate candidate on the ballot in one of the most watched races in the country.

This is the moment I've been warning about all summer.

The conventional wisdom in Washington has always been that socialism can't win in Florida. That the money would win. That the establishment would hold.

[ _**Every one of those assumptions just got proven wrong in a single night.**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b46bf69175fa4d17bea5f088b5e032b0&_e=EXCh2d-fq_UNcpVcdql0S6uc5l1PzQW3VPq_OGXCc-fI1TX8F6pWYLPd5rn9JClxo6QzNQ6bYpxiL16ehJ40-ocY1VaI8pk56TFyPM1SsJLLw4gKcz4mPyXQopK8XYp8kWrJTowMOiny4X8ehdKKz3PYgGt-JvtvLIS1nYQVZ0IH3X2qnAp2bvIwykPQUIufDDwehe-yAl8wbtfhUxBl-hv3Tt1SLKjdD8iqCKKM5IqKfRhQ9mf9DTql4KkG9HfnZdxnknocQ2Au-zYibxPsLu41hkUsovg6_K0Nt5zIdwAjX2vkGEg_KqFQjai2bclbLRSxgR9J1RbcAwgRwQEI_eOcb1i2RZ_mreW8-dRplCr9YnPDLpY8T3-TzuV9-lfKmF_Fd1HtbaYrxHmW2tFYvgvuaSz9qBtBh1M0Mc11jPenA_eqSvZSWdCtU5EUTpwJhxq4rQm8ZEXHzWDVEhw2QXTt1m2rbQd-rFzUlYU4VUXb1DwXFgWvZi_XZv0KMLkavt_Jn38cz6gb44RucPiDwusmcokgMMX2QqcZHZSvLoWSraUyWEEzIv0IjiABP2fZfT3dnoJykasFCsSBaucbcPygAHhVkEJwfOCFt2M39iwf2tPNgYRCQBzfMaJPZy6NGVau3-VF5S2z8_GqMBC8L2LNfjBdRP5vsH_tdg1hkm-1DAzsBV4hHzIvsJTC6EEyN8QaJo7_4Diw_C1z_GsY7hoiblXjZxpB9yKazKwT8A6ebAFKP2NhKQaqEK6e60aGOeNZsGw-Zuhvj5qbb6hQxQdilj6U8go4-lvun2Gi34kGwHZxoX4thIUv0LljLDRq5hSwu7Nn1xX9L-9mtpevnR2d0shpHEMtz1EdPoy9JAcsO07VqGH0t7PnKhG1aLN2knYqdcszfjQ-RPpWNEToJtL0bDHOQfrfESpqbfQpS0lz56vamVPZ6lwADtClVNNDpVAHuRAHsViLqVuk62jj1U_zDpwPhj9FztQbx3C8Sp82X3N-wUD3e-BPZ6CREPuyA45aMGIi3W1YmbLSTsZuIZc8dS0g268xU7SPTGc_bG1hcYYM3jGShyzaGRB9mifduUXCjjKrjLA5EISxt_AYL9dAUVZfTK1DZmGK6rMI3NE%3D)

The socialist left has figured out something important. [**They don't need to outspend us. They need to out-organize us.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b46bf69175fa4d17bea5f088b5e032b0&_e=EXCh2d-fq_UNcpVcdql0S6uc5l1PzQW3VPq_OGXCc-fI1TX8F6pWYLPd5rn9JClxo6QzNQ6bYpxiL16ehJ40-ocY1VaI8pk56TFyPM1SsJLLw4gKcz4mPyXQopK8XYp8kWrJTowMOiny4X8ehdKKz3PYgGt-JvtvLIS1nYQVZ0IH3X2qnAp2bvIwykPQUIufDDwehe-yAl8wbtfhUxBl-hv3Tt1SLKjdD8iqCKKM5IqKfRhQ9mf9DTql4KkG9HfnZdxnknocQ2Au-zYibxPsLu41hkUsovg6_K0Nt5zIdwAjX2vkGEg_KqFQjai2bclbLRSxgR9J1RbcAwgRwQEI_eOcb1i2RZ_mreW8-dRplCr9YnPDLpY8T3-TzuV9-lfKmF_Fd1HtbaYrxHmW2tFYvgvuaSz9qBtBh1M0Mc11jPenA_eqSvZSWdCtU5EUTpwJhxq4rQm8ZEXHzWDVEhw2QaGqvn47zFDLpY3HDiS4rFPiL_Zod9IXj0mcEOJslRvunl5815ZYUKbGh7-6C5ej4Mmlv-o1TYsE--xQyMypMwzFjb0h77H6on3Y0xUpi_WpmD1qdk-NvMBMKjmXQqGdxeIJachjqZsQWyTkls7NFcrh2xsk9wGVZ6hLstwqG5FfrBqNAOdyoNwBIK6sf9AD0_X_FwvTaULtPUp4wMGqupBk_lW3ae2UeKWtfAQ-iw5GWfLdREv8W_Dj7SJTuG-L7HX88tvBtptLVEbxWBYI1mC_WvRzQ-oNCLVIayna9fEwIXroi5G3gJojlgYrF-s2M_zMhpPfncOXl3xPolGxoPWvGSt1KhIc6REuvX9p9DSVDhZ4tfK7ScHuFCOLwRZZw7W5YNNk7zL7a6yN2V1vUXkR8rhjiYRzbFXiLj_9tzqO6wgqGLZwff1QtvNTAxGS5OIeF0IWCxzNKTW2XkLE349FCo51-YJj40iGewFyiowcf7O2HFp9j2cB8ZeCtjo_71pfgzeqAiGEsv1zhexwjgE30v5r56wp3Gf1ENfqdpNJyA0N9Eq_z2z2sH4RZ3pv9R7rmjr_4aPBhvzP1TLCduKmfj1ndHfsyWpPK_SxuVnwaNOjsx0Q76S-gqtBiHXNWhgXd4S4WTwDkAeiFk5_HC0%3D) They need their voters verified, mobilized, and ready before we even realize what's happening.

That is exactly what they are doing right now in Florida. And in Michigan. And in Maine. And in North Carolina.

_The money doesn't matter if we don't show up._

clean_body: Angie Nixon just won Florida's Democratic Senate primary. Here's why that matters more than you know. | Peter, I need to tell you something about what happened in Florida, and Angie Nixon just won the Florida Democratic Senate primary. She raised a fraction of what her opponent had. She was outspent 16 to 1. And she won anyway, by 12 points. That should stop every Republican in their tracks. Because here's what that result tells me. For the first time in history, a member of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) has won a major-party nomination for statewide office. The DSA, the same movement that swept New York and is reshaping the Democrat Party from the inside, just planted their flag in Florida. And they did it without the money. Nixon's win caught many off guard. Now the party has a DSA-aligned Senate candidate on the ballot in one of the most watched races in the country. This is the moment I've been warning about all summer. The conventional wisdom in Washington has always been that socialism can't win in Florida. That the money would win. That the establishment would hold. Peter, I am not writing to you today to ask for a dollar. I am writing because what happened in Florida is a signal, and as Senate majority leader, I cannot ignore it. And neither can you. The socialist left has figured out something important. They need their voters verified, mobilized, and ready before we even realize what's happening. That is exactly what they are doing right now in Florida. And in Michigan. And in Maine. And in North Carolina. The money doesn't matter if we don't show up. That's why I am personally asking you to verify your 2026 Voter Profile right now. Not because it costs anything. Not because we need your donation. Because the only way Ashley Moody holds that seat in November is if every verified Republican in this country is counted, ready, and impossible to ignore. Angie Nixon proved Tuesday night that this fight is about people, not money. Thank you for always showing up when it matters most. Fellow Patriot,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.
---

We ran the most sophisticated ballot-chasing operation the Right has ever put together, and we won every single state where we ran it. 10 for 10. Now we're doing it again, in the three states that decide everything this time. **America’s Spending Priorities Are Upside Down****** On a pleasant Saturday afternoon, a house in suburban Conestoga Valley filled with a mix of guests: doctors, nurses, other healthcare professionals, community volunteers, and neighbors who wanted to be part of the conversation.
They came to hear Nancy Mannion, and she didn't waste the moment.
With measles making headlines for the first time in a generation, Mannion said plainly that trust in our health care system has taken real damage under the current Republican administration — and that damage shows up in real ways, for real families.
Her message was simple:
Health care in this country isn't working for the people who need it most – babies and elders. But it’s also not working for everyone in between. She talked about what it would take to fix that — not tweaks around the edges, but a fundamental rebuilding of how the system works, including with how we price medication.
"It's not a lack of money," she told the group. "It's a spending priority issue. Our spending priorities are upside down.”
She didn't stop at health care but pointed to other illnesses that plague our country and our government:

* Farmers, the people who grow our food, are struggling. She counts a total of 14 farmers in PA-11 who've lost millions of dollars because of cutbacks tied to the so-called "big beautiful bill" and presidential executive orders.

* And then there was money — the kind that decides who gets heard in politics. Mannion reminded everyone how her grass-roots campaign started: with her own modest $25 donation. Her opponent, Lloyd Smucker, began his campaign with $1 million, mostly funded by PACs and corporations.

She didn't need to say much more than that. The contrast spoke for itself, and it's exactly why she's pushing for real campaign finance reform — so that a $25 start has a fighting chance against a million-dollar one.
House parties, town halls and campaign events offer an important way of seeing and hearing Nancy Mannion up close – with the chance to ask your questions of this candidate of poise, clarity and knowledge.

## **Week in Review**
---
**Packed Hanover Town Hall Focuses on Corruption, Healthcare and AI**
Nancy’s ninth town hall in Hanover drew a capacity crowd of 50, plus a waitlist, on September 1. She called for banning congressional insider trading, imposing term limits, and overturning Citizens United to restrict unlimited independent political spending by corporations and other outside groups. Linking corruption to rising costs, she discussed the Iran war’s impact on gas and groceries, and she argued that businesses and investments linked to the Trump family have benefited from increased defense spending. She also backed the “MediKids” proposal by Senators Andy Kim (D-NJ) and Alex Padilla (D-CA) as an immediate step toward universal health care for the millions of uninsured or underinsured children and young adults. Joining her, 169th District candidate Austin Graham urged community veto power over harmful data center projects and a ban on abusive AI surveillance and price manipulation. Both candidates reiterated that confronting corruption is vital to restoring trust in government.

**Recent Polls Show Momentum for PA Dems!**
If you missed our August 28 newsletter, we highlighted two statewide surveys showing that Republican, Democratic, and Independent voters are ready for change in Washington and plan to vote for it this November. In a Public Policy Polling survey conducted for the Mannion campaign, only 39% of voters said incumbent Lloyd Smucker should be reelected, **while 46% said it is time for someone new.**

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: The antidote to Drag Queen Story Hour
body:
We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded
ALA.

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e7537881/UaHR0cHM6Ly9vZGIubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3Yvdjc2TmFacm00Nw/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjA5MDg/LbmNsbDRydVFLbA/qP2hpZHM9bmNQRXF1QmV5dFA0b1lsc10/gaqAatQ/s6o6ceb8843

Patriot,

If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox
News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, PLEASE LET ME
TELL YOU WHY IT’S SO CRITICAL.
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the
library with a kind but stern librarian.

She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny _and _The
Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam
by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_,
_Treasure Island _and _Charlotte’s Web_.

BUT TODAY, ALL THAT HAS CHANGED.

Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of
the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used
to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+
writers and voices.’

Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn _and _To Kill
a Mockingbird _“racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls
Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her
“problematic’ _Little House _series.

And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for
“Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to
children of all ages...

A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their
kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism,
environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else
that activists believe in and fight for.”

Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a
new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the
air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change
the world.”

Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a
prince who marries a knight instead of a princess.

And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A
“family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to
“work it.”

I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New
York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.

[Image showing people, person, and baby]
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour”

THAT’S WHY PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS ACROSS THE COUNTRY ARE RISING UP
THROUGH SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY.
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.

For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and

| | What does it take to raise healthy, resilient children in a rapidly changing world? Moms are asking the questions, and moms have a powerful role in shaping the answers. Join Debbie Kraulidis and Kimberly Fletcher for three compelling conversations recorded at CPAC with Texas State Senator Angela Paxton, Angel Oakley, and healthcare investor Amir Mortazavi. From parenting in the age of AI to the powerful connection between food, nutrition, and health, this episode takes a closer look at the challenges facing our families—and what moms can do about them. Together, they explore how moms can protect their children, strengthen their families, advocate for better healthcare, and navigate a system that can sometimes seem to put profits before patients. When moms are informed, engaged, and equipped, families are stronger, and our nation is healthier. Tune in and discover why the voice of moms may be one of the most powerful forces for a healthier future. Full episode available now on [YouTube](https://momsforamerica.us/so/27Q21Plbo/c?w=PiKZ4g2-zvZOp_BwH7EWRbS6YtyvK3LvtZQJEInlJq4.), [Rumble](https://momsforamerica.us/so/27Q21Plbo/c?w=z5qtyPgQKA8UBEEOBDCSrdAucd9XvPPVCmQgxzNDWf4.), [Spotify](https://momsforamerica.us/so/27Q21Plbo/c?w=Lz6nh6CO0aV7UH1P430m76wptqyiCxKENhzpxVFmteg.), and [Apple](https://momsforamerica.us/so/27Q21Plbo/c?w=FjteizMR9l7uiOAl9075uKvoOrBVAxoy2F_J-X4BmX4.).

| | For 1 in 8 mothers, postpartum depression is very real. And yet, many moms silently struggle, wondering why they aren’t simply happy after welcoming their new baby. Postpartum depression is more than the “baby blues.” It can bring overwhelming sadness, anxiety, exhaustion, hopelessness, and even frightening thoughts. And it is not your fault. The dramatic physical, hormonal, emotional, and sleep changes that come with having a baby can make this season incredibly difficult. But there is hope. With the right support and professional care, moms can come through postpartum depression and thrive again.If you or someone you love is struggling, don’t suffer in silence. You are not crazy. The truth is, our gun safety candidates — like Jon Ossoff and Sherrod Brown — are about to be pummeled in attack ads.

GIFFORDS is working to invest in the most impactful races and help our gun safety leaders overcome these attacks. Anything you can spare will help us power that fight.

President Donald trump **[fired back at an aggressive reporter](https://substack.com/redirect/cc0220b8-2c74-4b57-87c6-a187bb2bcc5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** attempting to make him admit that the Iran conflict is a "war" rather than a limited military conflict in front of the press.
"Record long deployments? Why is it record long? How long were we in Vietnam?!" Trump pressed the reporter. "Do you know what we did? Iran will not have a nuclear weapon! Because if they did, you probably wouldn't' be standing here very long!"

# **Trump surges Truth Social with AI-generated images on Labor Day, the left isn 't happy...**
President Donald Trump posted roughly 40 AI-generated images over the holiday weekend, including a North America map showing Canada and Mexico annexed by the U.S., a claim that "the moon is ours," and proposals to rename New Mexico "New America."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/58d76371-93fa-4088-8e40-a712f1d51cd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

---|---|---
* **Other posts ranked Trump as[the "Greatest" president](https://substack.com/redirect/a559a88f-16ba-4c89-a878-c73a9f0be090?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** above Lincoln, Washington, and FDR, and depicted him arm wrestling Hulk Hogan, commanding a Space Force rocket, and towering over Canadian PM Mark Carney on ice skates amid ongoing trade tensions.
* **New Mexico Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham pushed back** on the renaming suggestion, saying the state's name predates the U.S. and isn't up for debate.

# **Lindsay Clancy 's lawyer asks Trump to consider pardon after mistrial**
Attorney Kevin Reddington **[asked President Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/59772145-0d7e-444f-8dad-294c19ac71aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on "Good Morning America" to consider pardoning Lindsay Clancy, calling her a "wonderful, wonderful person" after her trial for allegedly killing her three children ended in an 11-1 mistrial last Friday.

* **Trump had previously told reporters Clancy did "a horrible, horrible thing"** but stopped short of specifics, saying she'd face "a price" of either a mental institution or jail.
* **Reddington also addressed backlash over his earlier remarks claiming the case "crushed" the district attorney,** saying he doesn't regret the comment though he could have been more measured, and defended the holdout juror's right to disagree while maintaining the juror had improperly failed to apply reasonable doubt.

subject: We didn't leave anything to chance
body:
The special and the runoff took everything we had. November is less than 70 days away. | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=20f96e820ab74ff49183d3b127f6708e&_e=clwHMFfjQMbL7urSE7INFs6W13BPjFU-a-8hjQbiG7jBf6Mv7L7lxj-BQD0TIYtQkPzXwIBC450GxiJ3vrAyxmGDJE8YQh_mJoQKsYGITto0IEKGr_v3_OnvGMPxCFqEUaBPtlQzi656mTo9mG-XHw4NLliNFUJxu9XOQ0aGmN6Ecz80ahk6ZJMDor7orusbfqvR0qDmYd3BSfMni8JGCcREUD0x72vMU88QVhzerVQyw3MXankq-oq642RFWjtcMmHK9WAnOVyFU1EyKcsIl9etecsB8hbWh9MukR59A9CBoV9q2tcI0twzLy0f2KhnFro8TZ1nXOLaxKxEkgcfxm8MbTi2zGf7h2IXI_cIfUppdwYacoKtgmioLKJ432dZWrgHvkJJpByEwQ0QlJEbeuHgBCi9YZE6sU_uQwnW7j21Emif5Om7U2-bhWT-OqqkD6DrsI593T364TCm6uADbsyPw3Tb9so9OjkmDjBGu7oETN3_PkcOpAFRo9iC5t70W6hJxIOq-ekzuqNLhhJvzpRgbzyuzuxJ-esJSlTkBn6bRjzmtrjojzQ_5Wwg22F9PFjYwl6XnSB8nD2i9rAG7ecHqrLsBfQEuTP795xoUVF_H83TcSu0qjRthpu59LWqOIvMEYugmVGOg4EKh0QG70VAsZYfdnjA8VySYH1S0kmwgK3T6bXJ_mgF9NAWFgi3RSfpJBthIACzPwQaJWvGpppomcqrRCLNsGdKKZRFqOewDgOKQvQyDlGgg33Gcj47)
---
Fellow Patriot - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this.

_We just won._ Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff.

Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state.

**And it worked.**

But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes.

**Annie Andrews has $4.1 million.**

She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot.

Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise.

**[But I need you with me, starting today.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=20f96e820ab74ff49183d3b127f6708e&_e=clwHMFfjQMbL7urSE7INFs6W13BPjFU-a-8hjQbiG7jBf6Mv7L7lxj-BQD0TIYtQkPzXwIBC450GxiJ3vrAyxmGDJE8YQh_mJoQKsYGITto0IEKGr_v3_OnvGMPxCFqEUaBPtlQzi656mTo9mG-XHw4NLliNFUJxu9XOQ0aGmN6Ecz80ahk6ZJMDor7orusbfqvR0qDmYd3BSfMni8JGCcREUD0x72vMU88QVhzerVQyw3MXankq-oq642RFWjtcMmHK9WAnOVyFU1EyKcsIl1eKkKhqsZjKVes6-t-9oHmhzZR8C2etVlqhQJPJNnu_8oSYzUrlyX1vy5v1RwH3QzUREUKAfPIVwctQyHtEOxaxNjL081G-cLbpoXmyVNL0a3Kvo_1mYnKJrWXZGLpPb3MGgV-uynPWGU97Ct6BYEGoBJGfQVdbfTJ3ADxv-9j-CjHRkt8hePeIAjsXFh-ASEG6dOvdddpDEMX2IT5-nnieViLDZ28HT9KbPoFM49PyjICXLdoxmDX9O9WW58M0D1IhfLYVTQBOca65h63g_6iRupA-hrSc9fDZ4dmUxppleui_Qq9ZeRGhINvqf0WEVUHsAyS_wIcbaHEnpzYKxNG5p9iyMVorFUWpe3qvfvHNz9NZvDaaAdO0PblnPoOjhN6USB2l56iwhKKpVBHWETo_iheJ-6RcJ65PtVLwCqb1ENQgkbW90Pkxz014l9ojVCrL_jWuM-TmwpYwl6XxT_ACiyRl5_sbyRMjgYj4USi6)**

clean_body: The special and the runoff took everything we had. November is less than 70 days away. | Fellow Patriot - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this. We just won. Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff. Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state. And it worked. But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot. Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise. The general election is November 3. That sounds far off. It isn't. It's less than 70 days away. Every week between now and then, Annie Andrews's campaign will be on television, in your mailbox, and on your phone - funded by liberal donors who wanted to defeat Lindsey and now, defeat me. We have to be able to answer that, and right now, we can't. - My opponent has a $4 million head start. To catch up and rebuild, I need not only patriots who were with us over the last six weeks, but folks who are stepping up for the first time. name: Jeff Walter
subject: Bill Foster Stands With Socialism!?
body:
When they tell us who they are, We should believe them!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jeffwalterforcongress/bill-foster-stands-with-socialism?e=fa724b03ca)
---
|
---
| | | | | |

Friend,

How could Congressman Bill Foster do it? How could he vote to stand with the most radical and un-American force in modern American politics?
A week ago, on Tuesday evening, the U.S. House of Representatives had an opportunity to send a clear message to the American people:
**Socialism has no place in the United States of America.**
House Resolution 1490 condemns and denounces socialism in all its forms, including the Democratic Socialists of America, opposes the implementation of socialist policies in the United States, reaffirms support for free, fair, and secure elections, calls for passage of the SAVE America Act, reiterates that American elections are for American citizens only, and recommits the House to upholding the Constitution.
The resolution passed **220–192.**
**Bill Foster voted NO.**
Think about that.
When given the opportunity to condemn socialism, Bill Foster refused.So Illinois voters deserve answers:
**Why wouldn't Bill Foster vote to condemn socialism?****Why wouldn't he stand against the Democratic Socialists of America?****Why wouldn't he reaffirm that American elections are for American citizens only?****Why wouldn't he support a resolution recommitting Congress to the Constitution?**
This isn't about labels. It's about a vote.
Bill Foster had a choice—and the people of Illinois's 11th Congressional District deserve to know why he made it.
I believe America was built on individual liberty, free enterprise, constitutional government, and the principle that our rights come from God—not from government.And I will never be afraid to stand up for those principles.
**If you believe IL-11 deserves a Congressman who will stand against socialism and defend the values that made America the greatest nation on Earth, I need you with me.**
Please make a contribution today and help us defeat Bill Foster this November.
**Donate today. Help us defend the American Dream.**
Jeff Walter
Candidate for Congress
Illinois's 11th Congressional District

Here's how I could see us losing this race.
_The polls show us ahead, and the pundits keep mentioning the fact that I 've never lost an election, creating a false sense of security._
_Democrats rest on our laurels. We make investments elsewhere. Everyone says that we 've got North Carolina in the bag._
_Then, the polls tighten at the last minute - aided in no small part by a massive GOP spending surge that has already begun - and we're caught flat-footed. We don't have the resources to fight back and win._
_MAGA Republicans are able to buy this seat for their Washington DC insider. Democrats lose the Senate. Working families across the country continue to suffer._
I don't know about you, but I'm committed to doing everything in my power to prevent that from becoming reality. Today, I'm asking you to join me.
If flipping North Carolina blue and winning back the Senate is worth $5 to you, that's what I'm counting on you to chip in today. [Please, will you donate?](https://substack.com/redirect/3a1d4a32-8d1d-4465-ae22-6783abf6c897?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

The amount you give doesn't matter nearly as much as the contribution itself. Thank you.
Roy Cooper

A disturbing turn of events has led to **an avowed Neo-Nazi** earning the nomination for a must-win GOP race, Texas’s 23rd Congressional District.
In April, MAGA's first choice, Congressman Anthony Gonzales (R-TX), resigned following a disturbing sex scandal in-which a staffer whom he was having an affair with tragically committed suicide on his front lawn by lighting herself on fire.
At the time of his departure, Gonzales was being primaried by Neo-Nazi **Brandon** Herrera. With no serious opponents Herrera was the last man standing and _is now the nominee for TX-23_.
Today, in a seismic new development, Speaker Johnson announced he will be backing Herrera at the hilt signaling an extreme new turn to the extreme far-right for the Republican Party.

|
---
| [ ](https://jjajxo.clicks.mlsend2.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyODY4MDcsXCJsXCI6MTk4MDU1MzEyNTM5NzgwNDk1LFwiclwiOjE5ODA1NTMzMTY3ODM4OTk2N30iLCJzIjoiZDc4MzU0Mzk3NDc2N2E4ZSJ9)

### _Herrera_ , 2nd in line, dressed in a WW2 era German SS Paratrooper Uniform carrying a German MG-42 performing a Nazi goosestep march.

Herrera made a name for himself as a gun Youtuber and in his videos he has cosplayed as a Nazi-Paratrooper, flaunted his 1939 edition of Mein Kampf, and made crude sexual jokes about the mothers of school shooting victims.
In one video on his channel, he recreated the MLK assassination, reviewed the alleged shooter's rifle, and shot an MLK target dummy at close range.
Herrera prides himself on his neo-Confederate credentials as a member of the Sons of Confederate Vets. Refers to the Civil War as the War of Northern Aggression, and advertises an annual _Yankee shoot_ , where he and fellow neo-confederates shoot at "posters of their favorite Yankees."
My name is **Conrad Cable**. I'm the Democrat taking on Speaker Mike Johnson, the head of the hydra, who is working to restore Confederate monuments and ensure that people like Herrera make it into the House where they can legislate their views into reality.
My family has been in Louisiana since 1824 and I can proudly say _not a single one of us fought on the side of the Confederacy_. I am in this fight because I refuse to let Johnson and his ilk have their way and lead our nation into another conflagration.
**Speaker Johnson's fascist push must be stopped at all costs and I am the only one who can stop him.**[This is the fight of my life and I need your support to rapidly scale this campaign. body:
Check out Amanda's schedule for Sept 10–13 and come say hello.
---

| | | Dear Friend,
Our campaign is built on showing up, listening, and ensuring every community across Alabama’s 4th Congressional District has a voice in Washington.
Over the next few days, Amanda is hitting the road to meet folks where they are—from county meetings and community festivals to pop-up discussions and a grassroots town hall. Take a look at the schedule below to see when she will be near you:
**Thursday, September 10**
* **Lauderdale County Democrats Meeting****Time:** 6:00 PM**Location:** 3521 Cloverdale Rd, Florence, AL 35633

**Friday, September 11**
* **Foothills Festival****Location:** Downtown Jasper, AL _(Amanda will be walking the grounds and connecting with local families and small business owners that evening.)_

**Saturday, September 12**
* **Cullman Democratic HQ Open House****Time:** 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM**Location:** 105 2nd Ave SE, Cullman, AL 35055
* **Pop-Up Meet & Greet****Time:** 2:30 PM – 4:30 PM**Location:** 103 1st Ave NE, Cullman, AL 35055
* **Grassroots Town Hall Outside Rep. Robert Aderholt’s Office****Time:** 5:30 PM – 6:30 PM**Location:** 205 4th Ave NE, Cullman, AL 35055

**Sunday, September 13**
* **Pop-Up Meet & Greet****Time:** 4:30 PM – 6:30 PM**Location:** 110 21st St NE, Fayette, AL 35555

---
Whether you have questions about the issues that matter most to your family or just want to stop by to say hello, we’d love to see you out on the trail. Bring a neighbor, bring a friend, and let’s keep this momentum growing.
See you this week,**Team Amanda Pusczek**

body:
I’m running for New Mexico.

| | |
---
Friend, in case you missed it: **Donald Trump wants to change the name of New Mexico to New America.**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1350-fr-nd&t=1&akid=12309%2E400544%2EzkI1yd)
Instead of focusing on the issues that matter to hardworking families, he’s pushing another distraction while families face higher costs and rising gas prices.
Here’s my message: **New Mexico will always be New Mexico. **
If my Republican opponent wants to welcome Donald Trump’s extremist agenda into our state, then he can be the Governor of New America. **Meanwhile, I’m fighting for New Mexicans and standing up for what makes New Mexico, New Mexico.[That’s why I need your help right now. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help elect me and make sure New Mexico always has a fighter in its corner?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1350-fr-nd&t=2&akid=12309%2E400544%2EzkI1yd)**
| | [Donate Now >>>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1350-fr-nd&t=3&akid=12309%2E400544%2EzkI1yd)
---
Being New Mexican is something special.
Our roots run deep. They’re in the acequias, cornfields, lowriders, and chile harvests. In the food we cook and the traditions we pass down, and in the communities that have cared for one another for generations.
My roots here run 35 generations deep. I am the proud descendant of fierce Pueblo women, a grandfather who worked as a diesel mechanic and tended his cornfield, a grandmother who taught me to love New Mexican cooking, and parents who taught me the meaning of service and sacrifice.
These aren’t just my stories. **_They’re part of what makes New Mexico, New Mexico._**
So when Donald Trump talks about taking away the name and identity that generations of New Mexicans have built, I can’t just stand by. And when my opponent wants to bring Donald Trump’s extremist agenda to New Mexico and cut Medicaid, SNAP, and Universal Childcare, I have to fight back.
I have a vision for New Mexico that starts with our people: **higher wages, lower costs, stronger schools, and healthcare that’s there when you need it.** I want to invest in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatment, rehabilitation, and housing stability so we can build safer, stronger communities.
**_But I can’t do it alone._[That’s why I need your help right now. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help me win this race, so I can keep fighting for New Mexico?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1350-fr-nd&t=4&akid=12309%2E400544%2EzkI1yd)**
Be Fierce,

Deb

| Massachusetts Incumbent Democrats Won't Debate No Debates Scheduled for September and None Before Mail Ballots Go Out
Massachusetts - Mail-in ballots start going out September 29th. Before voters mark them, they should hear both sides. But as of today, the voters and press wont be seeing any debates before then.
Across the ticket, Democrats are afraid to debate:
* Governor Maura Healey is afraid to debate Mike Minogue in Western Massachusetts because she does not want to answer for a questionable $2 billion courthouse contract given to Boston Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley's husband, or for hiring a cocaine trafficker as her Western Massachusetts representative,
* U.S. Senator Ed Markey is afraid to debate John Deaton because the 50-year incumbent is afraid of a candidate with a political independent streak, with zero ties to Washington,
* State Treasurer Deb Goldberg is afraid to debate Elizabeth Dionne because she has not debated any opponent in eight years and is still refusing to now, afraid of facing recent scandals with employees,
* Attorney General Andrea Campbell is afraid to debate Michael Walsh because of her questionable actions killing a ballot initiative that got her criticism in the Wall Street Journal. Campbell refused a debate offer on Boston Public Radio with Margery Eagan and Jim Braude last month.

"The Democrats who chanted 'No Kings' seem to love to act like monarchs, because Kings never debate," said Amy Carnevale, Chairwoman of the Massachusetts Republican Party.
She continued, "Democrats refusing to face the voters, the press and their political opponents is what happens when 'One Party Rule' gets out of control."
Early voting has allowed for voters to be left in the dark by incumbent Democrats who refuse to debate before citizens receive ballots.

In the runoff, we came within just 273 votes of winning Paulding County -- a nine-point improvement in a district Donald Trump carried by roughly 37 points. [**Will you chip in $5 today to help us keep organizing in communities the national party has written off?**](http://clicksp.shawnharrisforcongress.com/f/a/JD3BSGcQeTQGG5Z96LQVbQ~~/AAPPABA~/A7ikzQxTJ9aBx3P0ra8OGXLsrnXT4mJohfoujreldJl39eaGWGdL9ArHeHBvuPzWO2zcvOMEA4N3uGdGY2URFt739VxDB_VU_9zjVgW25QNWROEVkwcuhCmDyIneI8ChUkpZVbryzrGvlHRBllPGBf5q9ZmgAMw9OkNWHzQqhx2pbOFvRuRP1u0LD51KWviv-ywGal-J4CzQJU1YUVznxotFuoZ82afsieMclLwLtCkHAk21KgpzXLYccaCpDal5B3IQZznZtmB02ajjmtIDS-kRirCM6q6vR0-24JonAy0YlSqb_hShsUU4vt5ZMgJ4) That progress did not come from a rescue by Washington. It came from volunteers knocking doors, making calls, holding town halls, and listening to voters who want a representative focused on them. **" When I get to D.C., my focus is one hundred percent you, your kids and your grandkids."** That is the kind of campaign we are building: local, accountable, and powered by people who believe this district deserves better than Trump-endorsed Clay Fuller.
