* * *
**By Wendy M. Yurgo**
What if what happened in that basement was evil?
Cora was five. Dawson was three. Callan was eight months old. Dawson was killed first, then Cora, then Callan. There was a first child. When that child was dead, there were still two. There was a second child. When that child was dead, there was still an eight month old baby.
I understand there may be a psychiatric explanation for how a mind arrived there. That is different from asking what happened there. Three defenseless children were strangled, one after another, by the person entrusted above everyone else with protecting them.
I do not use the word evil lightly. But if that act does not allow us to use the word, I no longer know what would.
We prefer diagnosis because diagnosis offers hope. If we can diagnose something, we can treat it. If we can treat it, we can prevent it. Evil offers no such comfort. It leaves open the possibility that after every medical record has been reviewed and every expert heard, the moral fact of what happened still stands.
M. Scott Peck's _People of the Lie_ first made me ask whether our clinical vocabulary had left us unable to talk about evil. I have never been able to shake the question.
Science can study the brain during psychosis. Medicine can diagnose disease. But science cannot tell us whether strangling a five year old is evil. That is not science's failure. It is not science's question. The failure comes when we decide that because science cannot answer the question, the question is illegitimate.

# **Elon sounds the alarm ...**

Now, he's sounding the alarm about America's $39 Trillion debt time bomb that could destroy the fabric of our society.

✅ The Federal Reserve's rate hikes are squeezing the economy, making inflation irreversible

* * *
_**(Piece continues)**_
I am an attorney. I believe absolutely in the right of an accused person to a vigorous defense. Present the psychiatric evidence. Challenge the prosecution. Make the state prove its case. But a legal defense is not a moral conclusion. The rest of us are not required to adopt it as our explanation for what happened.
We are allowed to believe Lindsay Clancy was profoundly mentally ill and still judge the act she committed. We are allowed to believe in mercy without pretending there is nothing to forgive.
Three children were killed. That was evil.
After the mistrial, someone shouted at prosecutors, "You only cared when the kids were dead. Why didn't you care about the mother?"
Because the kids were dead. Three of them.
There is compassion, and then there is moral inversion. One asks us to recognize the suffering of another human being. The other asks us to become so consumed with the suffering of the person who committed the act that the people she killed disappear.
And what happened next took this somewhere darker.
Hundreds gathered outside the courthouse dressed in pink. Hearts made with hands. Applause for her attorney. Letters by the box. A woman who strangled her three children was no longer simply a defendant. She was becoming a symbol, surrounded by something beginning to resemble a fan club.
That should horrify us.
Maybe evil does not spread like a virus. Maybe it spreads as permission.
Contagion would mean exposure causes infection, that watching the coverage could produce violence in someone who wasn't otherwise capable of it. I don't believe that.

Permission is smaller and more honest. It says boundaries move. Once someone crosses a line a culture treated as absolute, that line is less absolute the next day for whoever was already standing closest to the edge. It is closer to what researchers have found about suicide contagion than to anything viral. Coverage does not create the impulse, but how a culture talks about an act can shift what a vulnerable person believes is survivable, or even understandable, once it is done.
That is the second horror layered on top of the first. I am watching case after case of mothers killing the children entrusted to them, and at the same time watching a culture answer one of those cases with pink shirts and hearts made with hands for the woman at its center.
Both horrify me. The killing is not less horrifying because a crowd gathered afterward. But the crowd is not nothing either.
I don't know what was in Corie Walsh's mind the night her two year old son Barrett was found hanging in a basement, hours after she had been discussing the Clancy trial with friends. She has been charged with murder. That is an allegation, not proof, and I will not claim a link that has not been established.
But I don't need that link to ask what a culture teaches the people already standing closest to the edge when it spends months turning a woman who killed her children into a cause.
I don't know whether evil is contagious.
But I think evil can be handed out as permission.
And what happened around Lindsay Clancy makes me wonder whether we just watched it happen.
Not compassion for a mentally ill woman. Compassion is human. Not a vigorous legal defense. That is required. What I cannot get past is the transformation of horror into identification. The shirts. The hearts. The applause. The letters. The gathering around her.
Those things do not change what happened in the basement.
That is precisely what makes them so chilling.
We should be able to demand better psychiatric care without stripping an act of its moral meaning. We should be able to insist on every protection for the accused without joining her defense team in the court of public opinion. And we should still be able to say the word.
_Evil._

We have become extraordinarily sophisticated at explaining darkness. We diagnose it. We litigate it. We medicate it. We make content out of it.
Now, apparently, we wear matching shirts for it.
Strip everything else away.
The diagnoses. The experts. The lawyers. The supporters. The pink shirts. The hearts.
There are still three children.
Dawson. Cora. Callan.
One after another.
Medicine may explain how a mind arrived there. The law may decide criminal responsibility. Mercy may ultimately belong to God.
None of that changes what happened.
It was evil.
The question that frightens me now is what happens when we stop recoiling from evil and start gathering around it.

# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=848%2E127862%2Em-cQGC)
Did you catch me on Pod Save America? I recently sat down with Tommy Vietor to talk about the fight ahead for Nevada:
[](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260908_1_ak.gc7Dw7&refcode=em20260908-848&%3Bamount=5&t=3&akid=848%2E127862%2Em-cQGC)
We talked about the data centers moving into Nevada, how they're driving up energy costs for folks across the state, and how MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo is wholeheartedly supporting this effort to squeeze working families.
We also chatted about why affordability hits so close to home for me — growing up eating stale candy bars my dad brought home from the Safeway dumpster to becoming a single dad in college relying on food stamps and Section 8 just to get by — and how Lombardo doesn’t empathize with any of the struggles Nevadans are facing right now. **Instead, Lombardo essentially said we all need to feel a bit of _pain_ from Trump’s tariffs. **
But here's the thing: a podcast interview can only reach so many people.
**How many undecided Nevada families actually hear this message comes down to how many resources our grassroots program has to fund ads and organizing on the ground.** That’s where you come in.
**[I need your help to fuel this work and get this message in front of as many Nevada families as possible before Election Day. Can you pitch in $5 today?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260908_1_ak.gc7Dw7&amount=5&refcode=em20260908-846&t=4&akid=848%2E127862%2Em-cQGC)**

clean_body: Yesterday's Labor Day Parade: | | | | = | | | Labor Day is more than just a holiday. It exists because workers organized, fought their way to the bargaining table, and demanded better. Michigan has always been at the center of that fight. The middle class in this state was built by people who refused to accept less than they were worth. That’s why yesterday, I was proud to stand with workers at Detroit’s annual Labor Day Parade! | | | = | | | | = | | I’ve always stood up for workers’ rights. It’s a fight I’ll bring to Washington, too. Too many Michiganders are working full time and still falling behind on rent, child care, and health care costs. We need an economy that works for everyone , not just the wealthiest among us. I stand with Michigan workers, and I’ll tackle the Trump administration – who’s jacking up costs as I write this – head on. And we need leaders who don’t show up to knife fights with pie charts. = | | | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | | = | | Thank you, Jeremy | | | | | | = | | | | | | Paid for by Jeremy Moss for Congress | | Jeremy Moss for Congress 2211 S Telegraph Rd PO Box 7023 Bloomfield Hills, MI 48302 United States | | | | | | | | | | = | | | = | | This message was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | |

Friend, This weekend, Detroit was hit by a tornado for the first time in 30 years. It came right after storms that had already left many people without power late last week. During a dangerous heat wave, around 400,000 Michigan residents lost power, and some are still without power. In response, my team and I did wellness checks to help people in our congressional district. _If you’re in or near Michigan’s 12th district and are still without power or need other support after the storms, please check out resources listed in the P.S. below._ Ironically, the MI Public Service Commission, which oversees utility companies such as DTE Energy and Consumers Energy, cancelled a public meeting last week about affordability and utility bills — because the power was out in the building. DTE charges some of the highest rates in the country while offering some of the worst service. **For-profit utility companies need to stop raising their rates and start strengthening our grid.** They’re too focused on enriching their shareholders rather than supporting the people they’re supposed to serve. That’s why**I introduced the**** _Make DTE Pay Act_** , which**** would double fines on utility corporations that violate the Clean Air Act and then request a rate increase within two years of the violation (like DTE). At least 15% of U.S. households are behind on utility bills, which puts them at risk of eviction, homelessness, and even Child Protective Services taking away children. To change this, **I created the nation’s first water assistance and shutoff prevention program,** which provided $1.1 billion to help families access clean water. Congress failed to keep funding this program, so Congresswoman Debbie Dingell and I introduced the **_Water Access and Affordability Act_** to establish a permanent Low-Income Drinking Water Assistance Program at the EPA, funded at $20 billion per year. Just last week, a federal court ruled against Jackson, Mississippi residents’ right to clean drinking water. We must keep fighting for our rights. [**Could you sign on today to demand Congress support the human right to life-saving utilities — including water, electricity, and heating and cooling — by passing policies such as the**** _Water Access and Affordability Act_****and the**** _Make DTE Pay Act_****?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9HWtiGz5LuqdYdydHcioHinEQfQbxD14VkCXHOVi6YIYg-3pxftxZpL3y9ktqGXF3jAQFd1CW2K0Urm7bMsBK49o2KWIZ_PUBbZiMD55WwB9sBCHozPe1G1vGPTJOOM8LN9E4pqki7GL_czD3kWGQNktI182HPdRo81PzkZ6GMcYutSvr5VeFG4nIX2mKpw67hpnhowvxsaWPR_jFjAifae1jNsAOn5f16mGYa8NJ479lNGUQIX8YB2k2uEISqqHRZeqkx-hs-8WHHTX7X0Sb6oQTt3SQ8JSQU4kp8nHtplSjdfWi4xAG_i6ctd10jDRUJBQlAjXSUSwLEjyxxOd3VZTNTKDc1b_qN1kJDH8PgE_u0WdmpxSkWUMO7T7IFLxPsvlN3Nl-YU04qY2_Rw507TEmPmXfs2ekuiWjp6kFNilbnQiBEe7CalCHftC-fjzhhu85QMJ2brUkttXIuuhxK7gOodMNFU7SdXx66cqMSKxUkIy6Pak9N9fS36OZdiS7T982pAQ7106z1DCM7ljE3Q0iqUSrjlpbeu4LERJm-pkR6AoxYJib9D5Q2YIN-gJc/4tv/Mwj2ePRGSPGIY_zVsu2kGg/h1/h001.lt-p7Xk0VxLLnGcjPeNvvKRV4N9D4e-MzOip37wx0_o) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9HWtiGz5LuqdYdydHcioHinEQfQbxD14VkCXHOVi6YIYg-3pxftxZpL3y9ktqGXF3jAQFd1CW2K0Urm7bMsBK49o2KWIZ_PUBbZiMD55WwB9sBCHozPe1G1vGPTJOOM8LN9E4pqki7GL_czD3kWGQNhm-1PSmpQctKBk1S7lW81lA3HDX13g5Lpz0LMGWWdSLotMSswUw3wjkrun2JsU5kZMrSvv8F46mLKa7ktUjFcn_pN8s1d-doz10vO9xMgefM5F7JnbRk_MvSPSnQu4oJAQYUwiXkKLDGXrVsvIMklSJzkApJFIKLVtv1vZRkmKnF2XdJ1QCj8BEqnyFQ_yXUZlWYa8ClcQzhatUdvaY2veM51fgg1Lk_KYtsWyAvUsfytKS1A3T8fUTFKk-8fEpBuWqKro3iubxvcl1fjvwSUpy7t_YEZw81HvPgikJ4RSXEUKiN8gcayisjHzLV8-HfK9AX1atGE9esgJusQooYwePNwKUADilqLSPZRNaQZgtJCisO8hqWt4rypNW1ief-d-p8i0qj93RKuKQK3N4wURJTxd1UXBwuJngZrEXibhO/4tv/Mwj2ePRGSPGIY_zVsu2kGg/h2/h001.FmVdGKYL_L9yG-yj3x_pu9MNCKjqZyRt4pXkbMHiKrI)

Thank you so much for pushing for our right to utilities and other human rights. I’ve been proud to fight alongside incredible grassroots activists for years against water shutoffs and other utility shutoffs.
In Congress, I’ve also championed legislation to recognize utilities like water and power as human rights, to replace lead pipes so our children can drink clean water, and to improve our water and air quality.
As Trump’s administration keeps weakening standards for drinking water and air pollution, and as climate change causes more intense storms around the world, we will continue pushing for environmental justice and demanding the protections our communities need.
Always serving you,
Rashida

clean_body: Detroit was hit by a tornado for the first time in 30 years, following other storms; in total, 400,000 MI residents lost power. | | | Friend, This weekend, Detroit was hit by a tornado for the first time in 30 years. It came right after storms that had already left many people without power late last week. During a dangerous heat wave, around 400,000 Michigan residents lost power, and some are still without power. In response, my team and I did wellness checks to help people in our congressional district. If you’re in or near Michigan’s 12th district and are still without power or need other support after the storms, please check out resources listed in the P.S. below. Ironically, the MI Public Service Commission, which oversees utility companies such as DTE Energy and Consumers Energy, cancelled a public meeting last week about affordability and utility bills — because the power was out in the building. DTE charges some of the highest rates in the country while offering some of the worst service. For-profit utility companies need to stop raising their rates and start strengthening our grid. They’re too focused on enriching their shareholders rather than supporting the people they’re supposed to serve. That’s whyI introduced the Make DTE Pay Act , which** would double fines on utility corporations that violate the Clean Air Act and then request a rate increase within two years of the violation (like DTE). At least 15% of U.S. households are behind on utility bills, which puts them at risk of eviction, homelessness, and even Child Protective Services taking away children. To change this, I created the nation’s first water assistance and shutoff prevention program, which provided $1.1 billion to help families access clean water. Congress failed to keep funding this program, so Congresswoman Debbie Dingell and I introduced the Water Access and Affordability Act to establish a permanent Low-Income Drinking Water Assistance Program at the EPA, funded at $20 billion per year. Just last week, a federal court ruled against Jackson, Mississippi residents’ right to clean drinking water. We must keep fighting for our rights. | Thank you so much for pushing for our right to utilities and other human rights. I’ve been proud to fight alongside incredible grassroots activists for years against water shutoffs and other utility shutoffs. In Congress, I’ve also championed legislation to recognize utilities like water and power as human rights, to replace lead pipes so our children can drink clean water, and to improve our water and air quality. As Trump’s administration keeps weakening standards for drinking water and air pollution, and as climate change causes more intense storms around the world, we will continue pushing for environmental justice and demanding the protections our communities need. Always serving you, Rashida P.S. Peter, Abbott is resorting to cheap insults because after 12 years in office, he can’t defend his record. Greg Abbott wants to talk about anything other than the real issues facing Texas families because he’s the one who created them. Under his watch, our public schools are being starved of funding, our local hospitals are losing millions in Medicaid dollars every day, and our cost of living keeps rising. He isn't delivering, he isn't fighting for us, and everyday Texans are worse off because of his poor leadership. We don't need another four years of division and distraction. We need a governor who is going to be on the ball, focus on the real challenges our state faces, and fight for the health, education, and economic well-being of every single Texan. We're not scared of this fight, and we never have been, but now that the tweet is out, commercials aren't far behind. We need you with us now more than ever to take on these attacks. Thank you, Gina Email us: mailto:info@ginafortexas.com Donate By Mail Gina Hinojosa Campaign PO Box 300095 Austin, TX 78703

Dear Friend,

_" I rang the doorbell, and a lady answered."_

That's how Grace's story starts.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=60176f4fcb144309a40f2be6c2904c7e&_e=6ETWf8SoZuQpMy4paJ_Ejw8zIbTizDhzMikfiRrFwx7aZ6_5FFH92RhszEBgCtoXKqLHwwN6V1gnehPdPw3Aifwt2ejnkdmPaaNa0AJnxgX6KJF9Gagn0s0-cw0Vs9kTQDGNMbhyWFxI-ZgVXKQ4yglye8l732n23Vedk_mZLyxOctNnl_HEQL339WT49sHl--I_ZUWeESOOjw4nn2O3Y_JWB6leIrjG1CSmkPSpbhOv0d4u_67E9yCZ_wFdE_qVKZeJFxBoRE4ho-JIqUg1xQY27c7GQnwIoOlpyKW_mj5aOttnWVE1drJR0BcrQzUpAks4eBBwdFUKyqkSGNYC6J4dLKBAjcP66ZBtpbtpzkQMkxHpn7AyY-ZbjmQGys0StcwJK1Iwp0zBtSovJqaVwnLZJ-x22dROC7jf_2D5ua9ZOf4Kw-OI0Zq6iNvmlNn5bot1Ujxok-SacclhfRGLatedbcVthWVeQTyeJwa2ANHdN_EolUqkYEbNrBl2ao-aggDNjk1i2EWRczUZPjkU93PCIcZL50ag5Coe_JiRssw88X9hCQhyRo01pho_-JBHPoPm1CO2zPZ_ENvURCa6eGUj0ALpAPUlEydyxD4bei7o_gg44DSNmvx43-BYqWC-)

She introduced herself. Told the woman she was volunteering to protect preborn babies. Asked politely if she could count on her vote.

The woman said "no, thank you." Grace said have a good day and turned to leave.

**That 's when someone screamed from inside the house. A second woman ran out the door - she chased Grace down the driveway, shoved her, and hit her in the head with both fists.**

As Grace tried to run away and reached the end of the driveway, the woman threw a dinner roll that hit her in the face - **and kept following her down the street, screaming that she hoped Grace would be run over by a car.**

Grace filed a police report. The woman was arrested and charged.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Friend, this is just one story from one of Students for Life Action's door-to-door canvassers during the last midterm election.

I've told every one of our canvassers to prepare for anything over the next two months.

name: OnePA Team
subject: Private equity should not own our hospitals
body:
Delaware County learned what happens when private equity gets control of health care. Now we can stop it from happening somewhere else. | |
---
Peter, In Delaware County, Pennsylvania, we know what happens when corporations get more power over health care than the people who actually live in the community. **A private equity-backed company bought a hospital system that families had depended on for generations. Then the money started leaving, the debt piled up, services disappeared, and eventually the hospitals did too.** Prospect Medical Holdings bought Crozer Health in 2016 while controlled by private equity firm Leonard Green & Partners. During Leonard Green’s ownership of Prospect, hundreds of millions of dollars flowed to investors. Crozer’s hospital real estate was sold, the health system was left carrying more than $200 million in mortgage debt, and a promise to keep the system open for at least 10 years was broken. **Working people were left with the bill. All 4 hospitals that once made up the Crozer system closed. More than 3,000 health care workers lost their jobs. Delaware County lost its primary trauma center and only burn unit. A county where 576,000 people once had 6 hospitals was left with just 2.** We refuse to accept a system where wealthy investors can make decisions that determine whether an emergency room stays open while the families who actually depend on that hospital get no real say. **Our communities should have more power over our health care than a private equity firm looking for its next payout.** [**Tell your state legislators to pass a moratorium on private equity purchases of hospitals and protect community health care from corporate extraction.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39TyzbXIpOoq2iqzYMm8391MGwtxxepouc_6AYtC3AHXNCmTeS9sx6zodarSteAyKVv2UthW1sdHG9_QsaMld60T5aNmxLxhzRPY8OAEWY0b5wZ8Db_eilpZ_XKrCoLVOY5qq3BrrOynlcBhBzjhVpIG21ex0WuowTEVBFETXv1u3MBaiy0-CJJPvLkzzQY4Yk4IzQY0GI06P3K5n9iG3QSYw9LxpfwnJV-nXXSJP471WG3jj0Fmxt3qWaza8acCdpQ5Wu-fBqS-LxK0qT91ZHO38Iz28xphV1PLYlYMebpOLcmoMw6SP4sdgWHCy6SVEnBfxvvSzGHiudUlTt_evE4KCAaluvF9ygXkUGGfH_yuF_F420wq0-5oAOkz1Szb9jxKGjqNEDyEQNAGpwUyL914Y6mUjTcjl2rhkeBpWe92wJ76e0Umaq5YpW6_dHpEeE/4tv/cutOO5e0R3WyXOvJC_UEhQ/h0/h001.5W0eW9ue80Tv7sxvmjnz3NA-yh5wN7SCHXJBH-Hq4F4) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39TyzbXIpOoq2iqzYMm8391MGwtxxepouc_6AYtC3AHXNCmTeS9sx6zodarSteAyKVv2UthW1sdHG9_QsaMld60T5aNmxLxhzRPY8OAEWY0b5wZ8Db_eilpZ_XKrCoLVOY5qq3BrrOynlcBhBzjhVpIG21ex0WuowTEVBFETXv1u3MBaiy0-CJJPvLkzzQY4Yk4IzQY0GI06P3K5n9iG3QSX1-5p3_zmnLZUYkYXC-_fhzP7upYcetn7vBdqItST6aIxi4QInULq-WU2bGbLTqRyVh7CYLWd9Ab7VAUj2rsip3iEoxPbWj4180kRthsUH_HgkcICKczDkteZh5PJg-Pa_Q-J6_2gksFjJJF3IBfxQHhYE3JG32WmoWugMeLzlb4m0Rwig7oZUgoslY8emj4gfpr27AadxyD8EQjQdhMV6_h_SbMn0V08QsQjNRQvss/4tv/cutOO5e0R3WyXOvJC_UEhQ/h1/h001.FXsLuP2mfVxqNSng2WgThBRwQF3yrJwXQp3q-HMVkbE)
---
**What happened at Crozer was bigger than one bad company or one hospital system. It is what becomes possible when the rules allow corporations to treat health care like any other investment.** Buy it. Cut costs. Pull money out. Move on. The spreadsheet may look better for investors while workers, patients, and entire communities live with the consequences.
And those consequences do not fall evenly. When hospitals disappear, people with money and transportation may be able to travel farther for care. **Black communities, working families, seniors, people with disabilities, and communities already facing barriers to health care have fewer options.**
States do not have to accept this. Connecticut has restricted private equity control of hospitals, while Oregon, California, Washington, and Massachusetts have also adopted stronger protections around corporate health care deals. Maine even enacted a temporary moratorium, proving states can go further. But change only happens when people organize and make lawmakers act.
That is why this action matters. Every person who sends a letter helps turn what happened in Delaware County from another story about corporate greed into a reason lawmakers across the country have to act. **When communities organize together, we can change who holds the power and make sure hospitals answer to the people who depend on them.**
[**Tell your state legislators to stop private equity from buying hospitals. Put the health of our communities ahead of corporate profits.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39TyzbXIpOoq2iqzYMm8391MGwtxxepouc_6AYtC3AHXNCmTeS9sx6zodarSteAyKVv2UthW1sdHG9_QsaMld60T5aNmxLxhzRPY8OAEWY0b5wZ8Db_eilpZ_XKrCoLVOY5qq3BrrOynlcBhBzjhVpIG21ex0WuowTEVBFETXv1u3MBaiy0-CJJPvLkzzQY4Yk4IzQY0GI06P3K5n9iG3QSDergBFv_hvlTrA0C_UyaPIXkaO1cfH91YZwteIK13HGf6QsYL7IxBbeJTuKDSdlKU1hB0D10XnbfPvTT1IbaAYDSJrGC81Qeut7e8mmBn8m_Rt6fh5PzxOn8XpmOqfFPQ-5G9k7e9OJuBdqJ97hiZzpdrg-Fty_cnG4ksPmaFfM7gJ7GYQa-qKocMTkM5ct9KQfJFFKVfGrNEN149BhLRhoAkkkCWoJbWxhAhySXLGE/4tv/cutOO5e0R3WyXOvJC_UEhQ/h2/h001.oYWJCf8vzjr5r1xQhkK6BV0arIOuCdmz2OwDYbqqKHg)

clean_body: Delaware County learned what happens when private equity gets control of health care. Now we can stop it from happening somewhere else. | | Peter, In Delaware County, Pennsylvania, we know what happens when corporations get more power over health care than the people who actually live in the community. A private equity-backed company bought a hospital system that families had depended on for generations. Then the money started leaving, the debt piled up, services disappeared, and eventually the hospitals did too. Prospect Medical Holdings bought Crozer Health in 2016 while controlled by private equity firm Leonard Green & Partners. During Leonard Green’s ownership of Prospect, hundreds of millions of dollars flowed to investors. Crozer’s hospital real estate was sold, the health system was left carrying more than $200 million in mortgage debt, and a promise to keep the system open for at least 10 years was broken. Working people were left with the bill. All 4 hospitals that once made up the Crozer system closed. More than 3,000 health care workers lost their jobs. Delaware County lost its primary trauma center and only burn unit. A county where 576,000 people once had 6 hospitals was left with just 2. We refuse to accept a system where wealthy investors can make decisions that determine whether an emergency room stays open while the families who actually depend on that hospital get no real say. Our communities should have more power over our health care than a private equity firm looking for its next payout. | | What happened at Crozer was bigger than one bad company or one hospital system. It is what becomes possible when the rules allow corporations to treat health care like any other investment. Buy it. Cut costs. Pull money out. Move on. The spreadsheet may look better for investors while workers, patients, and entire communities live with the consequences. And those consequences do not fall evenly. When hospitals disappear, people with money and transportation may be able to travel farther for care. Black communities, working families, seniors, people with disabilities, and communities already facing barriers to health care have fewer options. States do not have to accept this. Connecticut has restricted private equity control of hospitals, while Oregon, California, Washington, and Massachusetts have also adopted stronger protections around corporate health care deals. Maine even enacted a temporary moratorium, proving states can go further. But change only happens when people organize and make lawmakers act. That is why this action matters. Every person who sends a letter helps turn what happened in Delaware County from another story about corporate greed into a reason lawmakers across the country have to act. When communities organize together, we can change who holds the power and make sure hospitals answer to the people who depend on them. Together, let’s build the power to keep our hospitals in our communities. -OnePA | OnePA is a 501(c)4 organization Contributions to OnePA are not tax deductible for federal income tax purposes Our mailing address is P.O. 1. **Elect Democracy Champions up and down the ballot in Georgia,** from major statewide races for Governor and U.S. Senate to a huge opportunity to flip the State House. We’ve got to support these campaigns and work to ensure equal access to the ballot box.
2. **Build on our momentum with more wins in Mississippi.** Last year, we worked alongside partners to help elect pro-voter candidates to critical, targeted local offices and end the Republican super-majority in the State Senate. This year, we’ve got an incredibly strong candidate for U.S. Senate to support.
3. **Generate historic Black turnout across the South,** making it loud and clear that voters are outraged by the new racist voting maps that Republican lawmakers have drawn in state after state.

name: Wes Moore
subject: Skeptics
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1891%2E1086043%2ElMqhN0)
Peter, I want to talk to the skeptics.
I get it. Politics has let a lot of people down. The cynicism is earned.
But here's what I've learned: skepticism is important, _as long as you make it your companion and not your captor._
I don't come from a political family. I don't think in political terms. I think in terms of results. **And results are what we've delivered in Maryland.**
Homicides down. Energy bills lower. Teacher vacancies cut in half. $10 billion in new private investment.
I'm not asking you to give up your skepticism. I'm asking you to channel it into something that actually changes things.
**[Can you chip in $5, or whatever you can today, and help us continue to deliver results for the people of Maryland?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260908-2.3PsoLY&refcode=em-20260908-2&t=2&akid=1891%2E1086043%2ElMqhN0)**

subject: Beyond grateful
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:

---
Team, I couldn't let the day go by without saying thank you.
I’m so grateful to everyone who stepped up, time and time again, before our fundraising deadline — whether by answering survey questions, by reading about my plans for making life better for all New Mexicans, or by generously contributing when we needed your help. Every time you've shown up for this campaign, you've made a difference.
It’s this kind of grassroots support that will get us across the finish line, deliver real progress for working families, and keep New Mexico blue. _I couldn’t have done it without you._
The general election is in full swing. This race is tightening, and it's clear the GOP is determined to flip this seat red – they’ve already spent millions. There could not have been a more important moment for us to show that we have what it takes to win – and we did!
With our continued grassroots momentum, we are ready to fight back.
But our work is not over. November is right around the corner, and we still have a lot to do. But I know what we can accomplish when we come together. That’s how we’ve built this campaign from day one, and that’s how we’ll win.

Friend: Thank you.
💛 Deb

name: Jim Jordan
subject: If this isn’t code red, then NOTHING is
body:
In a world of never-ending spam, I save emailing you for times that truly matter.
| Friend,
---
If every political email says the sky is falling, what happens when the sky is truly falling and it’s a true five-alarm fire?
---
**_Well, we’ve finally reached that point..._**
---

**My name is Joe Males, and I’m running for United States Congress in California’s 25th district.** [**This is a longer email, but I humbly ask you to read it and consider donating to my campaign at the end.**](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=17be6be7a367433695a8d9c3836bdaad&_e=IWu52MvwIgRCtbLTnSkmbvQOhmgELOVMOGlCxJISImDIcscmC7k1aTmidMCBU5eNOaLmbwr1K8-yLtPmsylk95RYGStjhMc_ovy1MWQJ8OmVN_uJDBHAhDY5zlWb__cnmcKs9--MOZMyPCdirGf0ynUd8ocjp9L0F9xqExlF-SnuMpQItDaUQtzWVGrj-nXePJgHID1aXEmUeA9UVZ_ccP-aZVyhCQb_l7tnamtbmZ9FYfihQoFWLXyqOxP5AWTIvVk2Z_p2kXTtpgUavbD_U8JCH1HkjVQ2u_r4qDitOmCw5zgSPUcMdFpfxd107vBFCce8DtwA6pjErpVJikJ45WuoV-5_ZDRXFrf88ifVTM-QB-6g-qhsi26Qngcld1ELgMcbKeK-XU66zDK4kszxYj984-OraWrN7LJPO1HXqDW5XqzIhBKssFeFfcVaE1NFYCxqIDN8P8zMk9JeBT0NMmdSIKx27zLXI2Ie8RgosoKcYhvxOU1QTGKB5rCQYKJdSKVmiYvmOhYpvd_6iuA9BZiZhvYfflNw9nMkGa-dxeg%3D)

**WHO AM I?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=17be6be7a367433695a8d9c3836bdaad&_e=IWu52MvwIgRCtbLTnSkmbvQOhmgELOVMOGlCxJISImDIcscmC7k1aTmidMCBU5eNOaLmbwr1K8-yLtPmsylk95RYGStjhMc_ovy1MWQJ8OmVN_uJDBHAhDY5zlWb__cnbTnLM7aVPn3-XO6Ka25eoCNUG5JQ7wE82NOnMlnZkBM7bvwJajSpXz20_rJAXMQH3qR1Dc4YimTtbIyU9SonlIdFKm3Crz3p4-xw8LtYvFHQ8pNtldAIvQ1iaoFP8_j2ETiTs5VToRlvrRF5SMr5rznIUXvpvtrjuaWmYBfqHGNLo-oct0kC1_JfSfc1N7_QkgQ9RQQz3LoaPXlyZ3DO07FCK8h1xOvhmyC5ZgTIHtLEqvaCA9kRAiO--wIMHn8xS8WEvUD6_y_ChVfBgup7-mBjL9gZoeLw6DKspTb079N0bFHYueXy23rJwWso9WaBSfBjV0k9A1Ulgz8ULNb6iaTbAY_7XjsxZVUm9dhrgbeo51B1g8V-Q3CbQXwtYGKxIYJmK22iAPo19YkCrk5d8g%3D%3D)

_Like I said, I’m Joe Males. I’m a Mexican-American who was adopted by two wonderful parents when I was four years old._

**At a young age, I joined the United States Marine Corps to defend our country and ultimately earned the rank of Sergeant before my discharge.** Once I entered civilian life, I started my entrepreneurial career owning a successful small computer business until my son took over the family business.

**Since the Democrats will want to use this to attack me, I will tell you: I was a former Democrat.** I switched over to the Republican Party during the Reagan era once I saw what the Democrats truly stood for. I’ve seen firsthand how today’s Democratic Party has abandoned working families. Every single day, I hear from constituents who are struggling with everyday challenges. I hear them, and I fully agree with them. It’s time for change in California.

**WHY DID I ENTER POLITICS?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=17be6be7a367433695a8d9c3836bdaad&_e=IWu52MvwIgRCtbLTnSkmbvQOhmgELOVMOGlCxJISImDIcscmC7k1aTmidMCBU5eNOaLmbwr1K8-yLtPmsylk95RYGStjhMc_ovy1MWQJ8OmVN_uJDBHAhDY5zlWb__cnbTnLM7aVPn3-XO6Ka25eoCNUG5JQ7wE82NOnMlnZkBNpoBIdJOA8QXwAXm8JWbLG_PawpvMxLo5uiEki4CID-Ygw3i6eTE9gXzH94qkehHNpH7SWipoQI_FkmMwVJIVQ-jhP-cDhyRdIf-HG_-_gshH8B2fpehrnzfXpTfNxLK8nqR0QWy2l0xW8bWJOgy9Sv2PzURt-nvXIn-Np04tw5ZLCBQsQJRThx6v5ndQssGRoihubeCtePDbI0nYsqWwTKDdWRq4OoJQsXbN9_UN7APZ3LTUxfLsSndel_AIvOpGb0YnOmSGAx8ucHcX_GbEIsCKFVe4tw9e_Zyuq5ZIhiDgUUaNsHDFtT9BnjaHb8T996XVDYoLm_553V1M83e7NJRfLbm1iHSZse-JQ0w1LNg%3D%3D)

**In short, my son, Nicholas, was tragically stabbed to death and murdered in 2016.**

If you’re a parent, I’m sure you could imagine how devastating this was for me. Nicholas was only 28 at the time and did not deserve what happened.

He had followed in my footsteps and joined the Marine Corps. He was a father to two children – my grandchildren. When it happened, no one came forward with any information, and the case to find the killer went cold.

**I decided to take a stand, to fight for the rule of law and public safety so that no other family has to experience the same tragedy.** Five years later, I ran for City Council in Hemet. I won, and just a few months later, our amazing law enforcement found the killer and arrested him.

**WHAT ARE MY PRIORITIES AS YOUR NEXT CONGRESSMAN?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=17be6be7a367433695a8d9c3836bdaad&_e=IWu52MvwIgRCtbLTnSkmbvQOhmgELOVMOGlCxJISImDIcscmC7k1aTmidMCBU5eNOaLmbwr1K8-yLtPmsylk95RYGStjhMc_ovy1MWQJ8OmVN_uJDBHAhDY5zlWb__cnbTnLM7aVPn3-XO6Ka25eoCNUG5JQ7wE82NOnMlnZkBPfWXUk4TG4H4GJOkGy8-mYvf2Z_UxwvAGggExZKOVvXZRbjDUgFSZItCc06mwTLB9JvL-9eHhVSWjj1IpemMSk6KW179iPBFRUzbIxJpOHEnTTFJta2RaeidA0B43rVpAyfPVvlXaHG92W4m8eMD4yZuTtRiIwp_SO8g6eW-_9QaT9oXGR9VG0ShbKxMnGXil0h9PxdVTIgMflWjGjFPK3bLoC7b6HZhbsoBRnrrLjfYGmWLrIVWDSFn4sOo4jQYmvuI58L57GoQWKI6R8BaKxzSbzIsBqMNAvJ220axCiuhqLmGhZWkZamdUbwrZToBPGK48OT0ntq0TyK81trEDvKkP0xYwB75EP3HTQFrBNpA%3D%3D)

_**As a former Democrat turned Republican, I know what the Democrat Party is supposed to represent. But ever since the Reagan era, they’ve continued to move farther and farther to the extreme left. Now, they stand for DEI, wokeness, putting Americans last, and doing everything they can to fight against President Trump.**_

**As a Hispanic American who lives in a border district and who was adopted by American parents, I fully believe in LEGAL immigration.** America is THE BEST COUNTRY IN THE WORLD! Millions of people around the world want to move here for the American Dream, for the opportunity of a better life, but they must do it THE RIGHT WAY.

**Our Southern Border has been porous under Joe Biden’s Administration.** Living in a border district, I’ve seen firsthand millions of illegal immigrants entering the country with the help of the dangerous Mexican Cartel, many through my hometown, bringing dangerous drugs like fentanyl, trafficking women and children, and committing heinous crimes on our side of the border. This needs to END, and I’m grateful for President Trump’s leadership on this. In Congress, I’ll always defend strong border security.

**On top of that, I am a firm believer in the America-First Movement.** After four years under Joe Biden’s leadership, America has become weak in every aspect. I already mentioned our border security, but our military, social life, and economy have all become weakened under the rule of DEI and wokeness.

**As a military veteran, it pained me to see the way Joe Biden withdrew from Afghanistan, giving the Taliban millions of dollars worth of high-level American military equipment, which they parade around.** Our weakened military presence allowed Russia to invade Ukraine and Hamas to launch terrorist attacks on Israel. I’ll do everything in my power as a Congressman to support our military so we prioritize READINESS over WOKENESS.

**Finally, we must dismantle DEI in every corner of the government.** DOGE’s work to cut wasteful spending has been a great start, but we must continue to fight to lower the cost of living, defend free speech, and usher in the Golden Age of America.

**WHY DO I NEED YOUR HELP?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=17be6be7a367433695a8d9c3836bdaad&_e=IWu52MvwIgRCtbLTnSkmbvQOhmgELOVMOGlCxJISImDIcscmC7k1aTmidMCBU5eNOaLmbwr1K8-yLtPmsylk95RYGStjhMc_ovy1MWQJ8OmVN_uJDBHAhDY5zlWb__cnbTnLM7aVPn3-XO6Ka25eoCNUG5JQ7wE82NOnMlnZkBNu2QdLaAM9l1AOmYX9dlk_PxUZ7crOfn8NhpbvkcrHafI3V2nh73iDYXHjLaSftD5u72Ep9Y3fBTv9VtK1W-1-Q-SSOgWox1NXxG2xZQHDICUiDmup7xFCgY0DshVt0WusVgcJpeCDW3RKW89PEcaqznWBAfTTl-KwsS1tnofr5dW_YsTCkdyu35YcRhXAO5s8UnKhw3RVGAjFnkCajQgiKpMl6knEQ32fNuH7m2akGxpAO9a-JmiPt6TJN2_ifieSAbTFIOxOlufB_s8hnW9i181p9a9tsvjjKpLGqefcUwKRRubCCLnqCyF_PDA65fCagDf671IhK5uo0qR3KqWr2IEUfU5Hh21Rqm_cPdzQiw%3D%3D)

**Simply put – the Radical Left has a stranglehold on California.** Just like they’re trying to flip Texas Blue, I’m trying to flip California Red. Dear Peter,

_" I rang the doorbell, and a lady answered."_

That's how Grace's story starts.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b33e87c7dff54b0b99b4356fef7883b0&_e=F3brXmuf0llOpw9H8vANiGuK7Rplv88j4wxaPdpUEHBUik_05P15ddo6pAGs1XDw8l5Et_03Rj3ryqTGqHPIZ0N7xwiM3u6t99hH0EbcS2yIpaxgiYwNYvsDO9DDc9_B-yMuGIi6cqR0NZjE62_lXvBs7RSb81AQlwhcBtor9f3sZhrln-TxTdvejonvCXGI0LOZTwg2VXl6mfs5QnvWFawTunVyQKOb4oY2xKNASsvkAn9_L8CyI_pgtz0drsBM3mHa6pOKFsf0ZSWp2ES5FcCG4sjbWPj9T6TVtgXIy9ZJOEW9QPsBf5DIAWK9eZVZTlwy9cVL0fg1jgUygp9cLSlKP01G6XXQ9OjIwecZkMJypY4-cMzG9G1LKhL7nBurRI7GIp2N6tPLxv6wbddfKITHVMk403Y9cZEwST5HHM_kW1s5wpOrrEd7XLWhkAqCOZwkanc8hHYNqVPo-eMuSyrJJe_M0RabXzLt3349s-On-gtphUECu3OChIL8Mm0rzZ-JOTD7VRGAjTa4x7ZebHUGm5QoCrR9X77Pi_fhWX-MebP5c4GFUTaeuU2sosDhIzI9l-F3lr2_7oeM2hDAIh7VpGVlIZ-C1Lxl5dTSr6AI3-Il5VnpGI4KjAC7X5tD)

She introduced herself. Told the woman she was volunteering to protect preborn babies. Asked politely if she could count on her vote.

The woman said "no, thank you." Grace said have a good day and turned to leave.

**That 's when someone screamed from inside the house. A second woman ran out the door - she chased Grace down the driveway, shoved her, and hit her in the head with both fists.**

As Grace tried to run away and reached the end of the driveway, the woman threw a dinner roll that hit her in the face - **and kept following her down the street, screaming that she hoped Grace would be run over by a car.**

Grace filed a police report. The woman was arrested and charged.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Peter, this is just one story from one of Students for Life Action's door-to-door canvassers during the last midterm election.

I've told every one of our canvassers to prepare for anything over the next two months.

I wish I could tell you Grace's story was a one-off. It isn't. Doors get slammed. Voices get raised. Sometimes it gets violent.

And yet our canvassers keep walking up the next driveway because they know if the Abortion Lobby seizes power in November, it will be a death sentence to millions more innocent preborn babies.

**_[Peter, will you please prayerfully consider sending a Care Package to one of our door-to-door canvassers heading into the field this fall](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b33e87c7dff54b0b99b4356fef7883b0&_e=F3brXmuf0llOpw9H8vANiGuK7Rplv88j4wxaPdpUEHBUik_05P15ddo6pAGs1XDw8l5Et_03Rj3ryqTGqHPIZ0N7xwiM3u6t99hH0EbcS2yIpaxgiYwNYvsDO9DDc9_B-yMuGIi6cqR0NZjE62_lXvBs7RSb81AQlwhcBtor9f2Mh1dy0aTyy0QLZtmLGN-YYvWSHbMmSlVCcsjLJWtWdSHtEgoVsgABy3RJnWomRcjiQq1khlxvtQu4X_eHHvKWO0MlsxfvwWRNp3iV_E9sX_xa-oIlkqUH3j7HO6iPFYlHBz2z6msdrwBB-SOeIHWDGk7hFqErrYzbZ0nJSHNOd-UcIfDimfF_LoRiYOSgUQv-CBFeKStnL9cxkT-AZUAl0oI7CvsB3oucbeZh0EXFAl7R6OqtlHijGYJGZqWi4wp9FSoNCJhnX3IoNYZzvdHi9LyYdQcLSonHz5lhdsLVTrgmZ3KJ11AdUtGPT6D6UXUdtvkC65vxLCYtAf0dJF9WPLDlCpl3uZR1dw4VkDoRjna9kJmo8_L-jCu7VFTrUUgs5OD49qB7xPBHjt84EycCnhVFAcur5VfFvuvrOM9I1fyAZ829TkKQ48e1_PD-BfNpHZ-QjuKg0tcm79pNaokHuEobKj0JdkCWsBYzxJpnKg%3D%3D)_**?

These young women and men will be walking for hours in scorching heat. Knowing pro-lifers like you have their backs will help keep them going.

Of course, I could tell our door-knockers to go home.

I could focus on running expensive TV ads instead.

But studies show that face-to-face conversations move voters more than any TV ad, mailer, or text ever could - and the effect doesn't disappear after one election.

**Voters who talk to one of our students in person are more likely to show up and vote pro-life again in the _next_ election cycle, too.**

_And, it only costs us about $3 for every door we knock._

Not only that, but we'll be deploying teams of pro-life activists to blanket church parking lots with flyers exposing the records of pro-abortion politicians in key districts every Sunday in September and October.

This is the on-the-ground grassroots campaigning that's needed to turn out every pro-life voter.

Last cycle, this approach worked.

***** In Oklahoma,** our student canvassers knocked 633 doors, made 26,931 phone calls, and sent 26,078 texts exposing two pro-abortion senators who killed our Chemical Abortion Pill Trafficking Bill - and voters threw them out.

***** In South Carolina,** we knocked 2,572 doors and made 51,371 calls exposing three pro-abortion Republican senators who protected the _Life at Conception Act 's_ enemies - and they lost too.

***** In North Carolina,** 1,052 doors and 52,554 texts helped four pro-life candidates win their primaries outright.

That's just a small sample of what our door-to-door canvassing team has done over the years. The Abortion Lobby would love nothing more than for our students to stay home this fall.

Right now, we're already deployed and expanding over the next two months, where this election gets decided door by door. Our target map for the 2026 Midterms is the most ambitious we've run:

**> >> Idaho and Missouri** - ballot referendum battles where the Abortion Lobby is trying to buy a win at the ballot box.

**> >> Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas** - U.S. Senate races that could decide who controls the chamber.

**> >> Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Ohio, North Carolina, Pennsylvania** - Gubernatorial and state legislative races that will shape abortion law for years.

**> >> California's 13th, Iowa's 3rd, Michigan's 10th, Pennsylvania's 10th, North Carolina's 1st, Ohio's 9th, and Texas's 34th** - U.S. House battlegrounds where a few thousand doors could flip a seat and determine control of Congress.

We'll be active in at least ten states in races up and down the ballots. And every single one of them needs boots on the ground before Tuesday, November 3rd.

Peter, the Abortion Lobby has the money, the media, and the institutions. What they don't have is thousands of young pro-lifers willing to knock on a stranger's door, get yelled at, sometimes get hit with worse than words - and go knock on the next door anyway.

That grit and determination is what wins elections.

**_[So, will you please prayerfully consider making your most generous contribution to fund our canvassers as they head into the two most important months of this election](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b33e87c7dff54b0b99b4356fef7883b0&_e=F3brXmuf0llOpw9H8vANiGuK7Rplv88j4wxaPdpUEHBUik_05P15ddo6pAGs1XDw8l5Et_03Rj3ryqTGqHPIZ0N7xwiM3u6t99hH0EbcS2yIpaxgiYwNYvsDO9DDc9_B-yMuGIi6cqR0NZjE62_lXvBs7RSb81AQlwhcBtor9f3y6SHALhMn9kKvpG5Jjezk1qUnTIOPXGBL49c9hiOpCfxoJhUN8RcsZNHSdYul5tRDg8c2g21z_VMS_b6KDEVOApJXYoxCpMnu1BSeN2TtU9HgMkhhK_LW8Z9gtXWo9Ang8NXhnEIDnu45KLmyZoLvsE01i8PQLFTOtdPLsAU-LeNwHS_HAGAmZ3ctZ1wFZFhb1m19yXGzcNXrEa4PtIE_cTpw1znPRE4W6dunLEsx0zkOP69x9CufZVyb0cJ4WD-8IESYZFLYEp_8b8JYLvTeCZDiHFcEXv2L953nSg63tALQUWJcYnogPWVBjUok75fTQwSsBXi4WzxHnxEa9AqSlPyFp2j0bmHkN4Lb2XjSKkvCWczBj1jblktH2u7T0Aj7CXoaIQzVtWs8x-sEUdhgaAnF-ccjvDCrkiMz9G7Xf9QkuGbPmeAHnkrMWVTHTi-X4XxfSMUx7rVpwbP7PQcYHLxAe3rwMLBu9acasqDdZQ%3D%3D)_**?

**> >> $1,200** fully funds FIVE pro-life canvassers for an entire day in the field - roughly 400 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time.

**> >> $240** fully funds a canvasser's entire day in the field - roughly 80 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time.

**> >> $70** covers a canvasser's gas for a full weekend of door-knocking.

**> >> $50** puts a canvassing team through a full Church Parking Lot Blitz weekend - flyers, printing, and all.

**> >> $25** pays for a canvasser's meals for a day in the field.

Grace didn't quit after that driveway. And this fall, our students won't quit either.

But they need to know you're behind them.

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. - Our door-to-door pro-life canvassers will be active in at least ten states this fall, targeting races up and down the ballot. Knowing pro-lifers like you have their back will help them keep going. **_[Will you please chip in $250, $100, $50, $25, or $10 right now to keep our canvassers moving – and protected – all the way through Election Day](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b33e87c7dff54b0b99b4356fef7883b0&_e=F3brXmuf0llOpw9H8vANiGuK7Rplv88j4wxaPdpUEHBUik_05P15ddo6pAGs1XDw8l5Et_03Rj3ryqTGqHPIZ0N7xwiM3u6t99hH0EbcS2yIpaxgiYwNYvsDO9DDc9_B-yMuGIi6cqR0NZjE62_lXvBs7RSb81AQlwhcBtor9f0ZgH41CgTPl1LpFXZkXlfhlM1d1gSX79hHzHsQB0PkC_Ywl5FVBgPAQvGB4_dpfvtV7F2Ztb9J5UytXbPw2eBiEJRw0pYEhX2nQ3mjgy0R3KRUSwlo9mrSB2IgcKbqsiTqkcuxMeEEuFItQ2XsiFukg-JryJ4lV0uw_T5LJbVnxDfkNj1fb527YohZtfYbey_5WZNnsJZTWTGsjpsMnh3YK0B1RJbvOfNqqQcPTz9-p61mVhxqq2bbufUrmdKfcd58lPRoWjDE8q0Y4BjZfiLSOsXANuv_42xyJpw_bU5CScNWnUXt8kEAztwm8iPQGbhItln5kZXtoLi1e5t4Qdz2bGfm8XflCHw8MmnqZYEmi8CNTYJE7hKPBiNLFLX5zvGbfmoZep5qcdkO5ngka65QVb_WbAoEHsICvYklaBK7lbCJRG18P_LSVmHQToAtVpPTPtaEPNM8KePlEF8M-NJV)_**?

Others are in competitive red-to-blue races, which is where we’ll now be turning our focus in the sprint to Election Day.

People are ready for change, and we’re proving that when we show up, run great candidates, and do it all without corporate cash, we can have real influence in our politics. I’m so proud of all that we’ve accomplished so far this year, and I am looking forward to the history we’re still going to make together this November. Thank you for making this progress possible.
Because of your grassroots support, we’re drawing the blueprint for how young people can win these fights, even against long odds. And even when we fall short, we are moving the needle of progress and laying the foundation for future progressive victories.

| [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=b31f2ecb94d04f609e48a4a132b63fdd&_e=eFHeewuFdgRj9Y1k1uaiGLRLijb0mKykDzDS3k9wAbB6IKFeNZfWKpv63iPHDB7WSgrf0w1vTe5_VVzYLBXMIaOszCepuGVGatGXqqGfoFRh5CNiW6Xj7G86mHmlTt41b7F9sLQriDu779jN_SquDtRXX96FYCGLPXRxO9QdNSbyHAAmEN3DbaT5gobwmZcF1spN1VA0HFIBCvXsFWBgMcFoO540YpB2zm8HhG2NhGK2nr6IWOabDLchQI4eONdQa1nv5NEArfBm6Lz0rLmb6jBPh8MRmkEBERSUmSVYtBqSgq6B0wcU-hCfUXnEtem6w1o00z2gD8GVrHXSSc87q_HM8Ejsb4A17pcKE-_k6PrVAX5aZKKiLvtxHtIOcCF_brX8A_MlWaTW-TTXWjMUe9N669-Q-wOq755btt7riA7R0k7lWyp6mmgvmdf5tsVqausKxtoana-FbEBPsPtLZ6gyZNgLguGLgrEHbEbl8TDWspY-2sjVGqx44ym0iKQI6t-fV2UoZJq89v79muajvwXLXinAjfMa8VOMyWa45rrRmB8EX1K1pk65XNbgGmfAWfRGkOBxgzodZkphiZq-LnFDe0zfAmEBbS3y1I-C6TanjoyjJD1gvWxoZg7tNY1TuABceKO24hqYfQhSElYJluu5KFu5bbIuljOKtihPyJo%3D)Dear Friend,

When many of us were growing up, the stories we watched and read reinforced things like character, responsibility, and a basic understanding of where our country came from. Those stories weren't perfect--but they helped give us a sense of grounding.

Today, the media children are absorbing looks very different.

So much of what kids watch now either ignores America's history altogether or presents it in confusing and misleading ways. Children are forming their understanding of the world earlier than ever, and without a clear foundation, it's no wonder so many young adults today feel disconnected, uncertain, and adrift.

That's one of the reasons this project matters so much to me.

We're producing _Star Spangled Adventures: The Movie_ --a new film created specifically for children to help them understand America's story through engaging, clear, and inspiring storytelling. It's designed to be something families can watch together and trust.

As our nation approaches its 250th anniversary this year, I believe we have a responsibility to be intentional about the stories we pass on. What the next generation believes about our country, and about themselves, will be shaped by what they're taught today.

I'd like to invite you to take a simple pledge to stand with us.

clean_body: | | | | | Friend, When many of us were growing up, the stories we watched and read reinforced things like character, responsibility, and a basic understanding of where our country came from. | | | Most politicians would probably love to have a safe congressional seat. I don't. Don't get me wrong. Running one of the closest races in America every two years isn't exactly relaxing. But there's something healthy about knowing that your constituents can fire you. It means I can't disappear into Washington.It means I have to explain my votes.It means if government isn't working for people here, I better find out why. Most seats in Congress are decided before November. The gerrymandered map does the work, the primary picks the winner, and the general is a formality — which means a member only ever has to answer to the voters of their own party who show up in August. Southwest Washington doesn't work like that. I have to earn votes from people who voted for Donald Trump, people who voted for Kamala Harris, and plenty of people who don't particularly like either party. I actually think that makes me better at my job. Unfortunately, it also means national Republicans know this is one of the few seats they can actually take. They've already spent more than $10 million in advertising against me. That's the part I want to be honest about. Accountability is good. Being outspent is not. The same thing that keeps me useful—a district that could go either way—is what puts a target on this seat, and there's no version where I get one without the other. I'm not asking you for money so I can have an easy race. I've never had one, and I'm not sure I'd want one. I'm asking so that when Southwest Washington makes this decision in November, it's made by the people who live here — not by whoever bought the most airtime. **[If you're with me, pitch in $5 or more today. name: Enoch for Congress
subject: What a Weekend! And We’re Just Getting Started
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch
body:
From Labor Day weekend to the Harvest Home Parade, LULAC Candidate Forum, and Hair. Housing. & Healthcare.—we have a big week ahead!

| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| |
# Happy Labor Day, and Thank You!

Dear Peter,
I hope you and your family had a **safe, relaxing, and fun Labor Day weekend!** Our campaign had an **extremely busy weekend** , and I’m grateful for every volunteer, supporter, community leader, and voter who spent time with us.
On **Friday** , we held **The Ground Game Experience** , bringing together Precinct Executives, candidates and volunteers to strengthen our grassroots organizing and prepare for the work ahead.
On **Saturday** , we joined the community for the **Lincoln Heights Parade** and attended the **AFL-CIO Labor Day event featuring Dr. Amy Acton and Pete Buttigieg**. It was a great opportunity to celebrate working people and the organized labor movement that has fought for generations to improve wages, workplace protections, benefits, and economic opportunity for American families.
On **Sunday** , I was able to spend some much-needed time with family.And on **Monday, Labor Day, I rested!** After a very full weekend and an even busier campaign season, that rest was definitely needed.
Now, we’re back at it, and **we have a big week ahead!**

### Wednesday: LULAC Candidates Forum

I will be participating in a **Candidates Forum hosted by the League of United Latin American Citizens (LULAC)**.**Wednesday, September 9**
**5:30–7:30 PM**
**Fueled Collective**
3825 Edwards Rd., Suite 103
Cincinnati, OH
I look forward to discussing the issues affecting families across our district and sharing my vision for representing Ohio’s 8th Congressional District in Washington.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/5xLpC2aFbqx?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)

### Thursday: Walk With Us in the Harvest Home Parade!
**Come walk with Team Enoch!** We will be participating in the **Harvest Home Parade this Thursday** , and we need volunteers to join us.**Thursday, September 10**
**5:00 PM** Walking in a parade is one of the easiest—and most fun—ways to help the campaign. Come out, wear your Enoch gear if you have it, meet other supporters, and help us introduce our campaign to voters.[**Sign up to volunteer at CampaignHQ:**
](https://us.list-manage.com/pjIKtLHQo8g?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)[campaignhq.app/volunteer](https://us.list-manage.com/_gIkTk0IpUo?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)

### Saturday: Hair. Housing. & Healthcare. — It All Hits Home.
Then, on Saturday, I hope you’ll join us for a very special campaign fundraising event. The event is focused on issues specific to the black community and communities of color, however all are welcome. Some of the issues that communities of color face aren’t limited to these specific communities:[](https://us.list-manage.com/12r3TqAR8Aq?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)

## **HAIR. HOUSING. & HEALTHCARE.**
### **It All Hits Home.**
This will be more than a fundraiser. We are bringing people together for a **panel discussion about issues that directly affect our families, our communities, and our future** , followed by a community meet & greet.
**Saturday, September 12, 2026**
**2:00–4:00 PM**
**The Pike Bar & Grill**
10010 Springfield Pike
Cincinnati, OH 45215
Our panel will include voices from across our community—an historian, judicial candidate, political science student, counselor and real estate investor, salon owner, healthcare professional, and me as your Democratic candidate for Congress in Ohio’s 8th District.
And yes—**food and drinks will be served while they last!**
Suggested donations are **$25, $50, $100, $250, or $500+** , but most importantly, I want you to come, participate in the conversation, and help us build the kind of grassroots movement that can win this race.
[**RSVP, donate, volunteer, and get involved through CampaignHQ:**
campaignhq.app](https://us.list-manage.com/A1sqPYu1hPV?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)or [https://campaignhq.app/rsvp/hair-politics-and-power](https://us.list-manage.com/SWItLPRLS1I?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
Every parade we walk, every door we knock, every conversation we have, and every voter we reach moves us one step closer to sending new leadership to Congress.**I hope to see you somewhere along the campaign trail this week!**
With gratitude,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch, Ph.D., MBA**
Democratic Candidate for Congress
Ohio’s 8th Congressional District
**Enoch for Congress**
_Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch. Catherine Johnson, Treasurer._
